projects.summary: SnapFire FSR is a full stack runtime that lets frontend teams write typescript and have it served via Rust. At my current workplace (10M+ DAUs), all we want to do was render composed strings from the backend to a browser using Typescript. Since Node 0.x (went I started with Node), things have changed, freedoms taken away and now security teams recommend to wrap your Node server instance with a sidecar or else your Node project will be blocked. SnapFire FSR changes that for us, no more sidecars. The idea is, you don't need a general purpose VM to compose a web page. Most complex transformations and communications are done by our services anyway. When you need complex computation done without a service then create native Rust functions and call it via Typescript. There is a long list of ideas from my past experience with frontend and backend that contributed to SnapFire FSR. In the end, FSR answers my question "Can we specialize our web applications to our full stack needs and security concerns?"

projects.author: sean2020
projects.summary: GitHub: https://github.com/xsean2020/Moppet （ Apache-2.0 ，Swift 6 / macOS 14+） macOS 清理工具，两个不一样的地方： 1 ）内置一个 Codex 级的 agent 。你说"清理浏览器缓存"，它先扫描给你看，等你批准才删。 沙箱、审批策略、补丁应用、会话恢复都是自己实现的；另外提供 23 个工具的 MCP 服务器， Claude Code / Cursor 可以直接调用同一套清理能力。 2 ）交互层是只 3D 桌宠（ SceneKit 程序化生成，没有 WebView 、没有 Electron ）， AI 要删东西时头顶弹批准卡，结果进气泡。 安全上比较较真：只删家目录、25 类保护路径、白名单命中及其子树永不触碰、 删除前二次校验、逐路径审计； AI 每次删除都要审批，MCP 要 confirmed + token ， HTTP 只绑 127.0.0.1 。 11 个模块：清理 / 卸载 / 优化 / 启动项 / 分析 / 状态 / 项目清理 / 瘦身 / 历史 / 设置 / 总览。 限制说在前面：AI 要自己的 API key ；瘦身仅 Apple Silicon ；系统级操作要管理员密码； 上不了 App Store ；没有 dmg ，源码构建；只在我这台 Intel Mac 验证过（ arm64 交叉编译通过）。 试一下： git clone https://github.com/xsean2020/Moppet.git && cd Moppet && swift build .build/debug/Moppet 不想开 GUI 就跑自测（ 133 项断言，1.4 秒，不删任何文件）： swift run Moppet --smoke 想听意见：AI 有删除权但每一步都要点头，这个颗粒度合适吗？ 觉得有用的话求个 star 。

projects.title: 开源了一个 MCP 治理网关： Jev 判 0.94、d3 判 0.70，两个判官说不同的话时怎么办
projects.author: Thneonl
projects.summary: 给 AI agent 做了个 MCP 执法网关（ Rust ），核心问题：当两个决策模型对同一件事给出不同判断时，怎么安全处理？ 实测：同一个越权场景（ coding agent 试图 merge 夹带无关变更的 PR ）： - Jev 给 0.94 置信度 → 准入层 Accept → 授权挂起 → DENY - d3 （ vLLM SR ）给 0.70 → Hold → 什么都不改 → ALLOW 两个都对。分歧不是 bug ，是校准本性（ d3 ECE 4.3 vs Jev 8.0 ）。治理层的价值在于让分歧安全。 网关做的事：每个 tools/call 先过 r2r_decide 门控，ALLOW 转发上游，DENY 返回 isError + 证据文本（相位 + 规则 + 事件 ID ），全程审计到 EventStore 。 零 API key 复现： cargo run -- fixture cargo run -- fixture --provider d3 GitHub: https://github.com/Thneoly/r2r-jev （ Apache-2.0, v0.2.0 ）

projects.title: Show HN: ReVault – new secure archive format
projects.author: bsutto
projects.summary: reVault is a new, secure-by-default archive format called a lockbox, designed to be simple to use. I've been working on reVault for about 2 years. It was originally written in Dart, but with the improvements in AI, I decided to port it to Rust using AI. It's now in beta, so I'm looking for feedback, particularly around the different language bindings. A lockbox is encrypted, signed and compressed by default. Each can be disabled selectively. - Hybrid post-quantum or passphrase encryption, including metadata. - Zstd compression. - Pure Rust libraries wherever possible. We intend to phase out remaining C code as alternatives become available. The project has been scanned using OpenAI's Daybreak cyber security tools. The manual is a work in progress: https://docs.revault.onepub.dev/ reVault supports Linux, macOS and Windows, x64 and arm64, plus Wasm. The core is Rust, with bindings for C/C++, Java, Dart, Python, Ruby, JS/TypeScript, Go, C#, Kotlin, Lua, PHP and Swift. Within a lockbox you can store: - Files, directories, permissions and symlinks. - Variables. - Forms. Variables, forms and the lockbox itself can have descriptions. reVault uses a portable vault (just another lockbox with structured content) to hold your keys, contacts' keys, lockbox aliases and form definitions. It ties into your platform's secure store, so logging into your desktop unlocks your vault. You don't have to enter a passphrase every time you access a lockbox. You can disable this. There are lots of shortcuts. Creating a lockbox stores an alias in your vault, based on its filename or a name you choose: lbx create /some/path/mybox.lbox lbx mybox open --duration 1h lbx mybox var set KEY VALUE Set a default lockbox and you can leave its name out: lbx session default mybox lbx var get KEY You can mirror a directory tree into a lockbox and update it when the directory changes: lbx store.lbox mirrors project create --from ./project --to /projects/project lbx store.lbox mirrors update The API lets you read, write and seek within files without extracting them to the filesystem. Each lockbox has a table of contents, so extracting a single file from a multi-gigabyte lockbox is fast. Recovery Updates are transactional, with automatic rollback for failed updates. The format is designed for recovery: content is stored in pages, allowing unaffected content to be recovered if part of a lockbox is corrupted. Sharing An encrypted lockbox is more useful if you can share it. reVault has an open-source keyserver for exchanging public keys, with validation through a second trusted channel. It's still experimental. OnePub has donated a server to run a single keyserver. If you're interested in donating resources, I'd like to bring up a second redundant server. It's pure Rust, uses under 100 MB RSS and supports rate limits. To publish your default profile's public key: lbx vault profiles email you@example.com lbx vault profiles publish Give the publish code to your contact. They can import your key: lbx vault contacts receive <publish-code> <contact-name> Display your profile's fingerprint and exchange it through a second trusted channel: lbx vault profiles fingerprint Repeat the process in the opposite direction to get their key. Once you have it, grant them access to your default lockbox: lbx access grant alice You can then email the encrypted lockbox to Alice. To install the CLI and get started: cargo install revault_cli lbx vault init lbx completion install Completion installation detects your shell. projects.author: wlmosv-png

github.name: wlmosv-png/wpaforge
github.description: Android 原生 WPA/WPA2 密码审计工具：按 SSID 现场派生候选而非翻大字典，逐条真实关联验证，只认同一行里的 4-Way Handshake 完成。含 WPS 四层候选与拆半攻击、局域网侦察、.cap/.hc22000 离线校验。纯 Root。 | Native Android WPA/WPA2 audit tool: SSID-derived candidate generation, handshake-only verification, WPS, LAN recon. Root only.

projects.summary: WPAForge 是一个跑在安卓手机上的 WPA/WPA2 弱口令审计工具，开源（Apache-2.0），需要 Root。 它不翻几百万条的通用字典，而是按目标路由器的 SSID 现场派生候选——比如路由器叫 FASTE972，它就先生成 FASTE972、faste972、97297297、e9721188 这些，几百条覆盖常见命名习惯，再按目标特征排序，最可能的排最前。命中通常发生在第几十条，而不是第几万条。 每条候选都真的向目标 AP 发一次关联请求，不模拟、不猜测；判定只认一种证据：4-Way Handshake 完成，且 SSID、supplicant 状态、IP 三条同源于同一条记录，所以不会有“假成功”。 其他：进度实时存盘、中断能接着跑、锁屏继续；多目标后台队列；内置 IEEE OUI 表（15913 条），列表里直接显示水星 / 中兴 / 腾达 / 迅捷等厂商名。 要求：Android 8.0+、Root。适用范围仅限你自己拥有或已获明确授权的网络——对自家路由器是排查弱口令，对别人的网就是违法，这条边界很清楚。 亮点 1. 不用电脑、不用外置网卡、不用 Termux —— 安卓原生，一台 Root 手机跑完全流程。传统路子要笔记本 + 支持监听模式的网卡 + Kali，这套只要一个 APK。 2. 按目标 SSID / BSSID 现场派生候选，而不是翻大字典。派生维度：SSID 原文与大小写变形、里面数字串的重复与加后缀、去掉分隔符的合并串、SSID 与高频数字的多种拼接、BSSID 尾号族，再叠通用弱口令与厂商规则。几百条排在队列最前面，通常第几十条就命中。 3. 判定链只认一种证据：SSID 逐字相等 + supplicant COMPLETED + 有效 IP。而且刻意不让 netId 参与判定 —— 早期把它当否决条件时出过真实事故：密码是对的、系统确实连上了，却因为 netId 时序对不上而整段跳过成功判断。netId 现在只作为证据强度标注。宁可报「不确定」，也不报假成功。 4. 断点续跑 + 后台队列 + 锁屏继续。进度实时存盘，多目标排队自动跑，每项可单独暂停。 5. 内置 IEEE OUI 表 15913 条，扫描列表直接显示「水星 / 中兴 / 腾达 / 迅捷 / 四川天邑康和」，随机化 MAC 单独标注，不和「未收录」混着显示。 6. 核心判定与派生全是纯逻辑，不依赖 Android —— 可以离线跑单测。 7. Apache-2.0，无广告、无内购、不上传任何数据。

projects.title: Show HN: Ocel – Deploy apps to your AWS,GCP or VPS with infra from code
projects.author: vndaba
projects.summary: Hey HN, I’m Victor and I’ve been building Ocel, an open source CLI, Console and SDK for deploying your apps and the infra they need to your own AWS/GCP/VPS. The CLI: Run ‘ocel deploy’ in your existing apps, and deploy to a configured target, no separate IaC files required. The SDK: Declare infra your app needs as code within the app itself, the CLI builds and provisions with no extra steps when deploying. Rust, Go, Python and Typescript supported. The Console: Optional self-hostable UI for an otherwise CLI-first product. The neat part is that the console itself is an app built with the sdk and deployed with the CLI ! You can try it out to deploy your apps to your own infra. VPS is well tested, and AWS+Cloudflare is also quite well covered. I’ve been dogfooding this myself for things I’m building. Please expect bugs, as it’s still early days. Why ? I’ve been a big fan and user of SST for a long time (personal and professional projects). The DX is genuinely unmatched and the high-level components make things quite easy. I think they proved that most apps don’t need complex IaC code, and abstracting things behind high level components/primitives, with some customization levers, actually works quite well. Ocel builds on that by taking it a bit further, no infra code, have a similar ‘high level components’ approach, but directly in the app. And support deploying existing apps or frameworks from day one in the CLI. You should be able to cd into an existing app and just deploy! (Of course theres a bit more like providing credentials to the platform you are deploying to, domains, one-time setup, etc). Everything else is the gripes I had after deploying tons of apps with SST: - Preview and production separation built in, so previews can share heavy resources and be considerably faster - First class support for separating the origin and edge, so composing AWS and cloudflare (common setup I had) becomes a breeze - CLI-first product, but with a UI console that can also be self hosted for things like team management, setting env vars, etc. - More SDK primitives (Realtime, Tasks, Pubsub topics, etc) that give a BaaS-like experience no matter where you deploy

projects.summary: Instead of trying to run DOOM on things, I have instead decided to use DOOM (many, many, many doom games actually) to create a transformer. For a lot of the math required I essentially had to use DOOM game mechanics and voodoo dolls (DOOM is turing complete btw) and exchange them with the actual operations, essentially creating an alternative to NumPy (a 65000x slower one). Thus, I am proud to present DOOMFORMER. Here are a list of things DOOMFORMER can do : It can classify MNIST digits, even if you write these digits on the map! It can talk(kinda) You can use it to make decisions, so, it can play DOOM. Yes! You can play DOOM with thousands of DOOM games now! The marine's mind can be controlled by DOOM, playing on a map generated by DOOMFORMER. Truly, the possibilities are endless, and even larger-scale training of DOOMFORMER could be done on a measly T4. projects.title: [分享] 给科研人员做了一个 Zotero AI 插件 BibGenie
projects.author: RuiCBai
projects.summary: 大家好，我是 [BibGenie]( https://bibgenie.com) 的开发者，来分享一下自己做了一年多的东西，也想听听 V 站里还在用 Zotero 看文献的朋友的真实反馈。 ## 背景说明 用 Zotero 的应该都知道，它是科研圈最主流的开源文献管理工具，但本身没有任何 AI 能力。我自己读论文时有个很具体的痛点：把论文丢给 AI 问，答案说得头头是道，但我根本不知道它是从哪篇、哪一页得出的结论，最后还得自己回去翻 PDF 核对，费时费力。 所以我做了 BibGenie （去年叫 Zotero Copilot ，但因为 Zotero 商标的问题改了名），一个原生跑在 Zotero 里面的 AI 插件，侧边栏形态，可以直接访问官网 https://bibgenie.com 查看首页的展示视频，视频会更加直观。 迭代了一年多，目前更新到 v0.9.4 版本了，核心功能都已经开发完成了，今天来 V2EX 求一点反馈 （顺便吐槽一下，现在很多独立开发者只顾哐哐开发新产品，却不管维护，我也是深受其害。） ## 核心功能大概是这几块： 1. 直接和自己的 Zotero 整个文库对话。 不用导出文件、不用把 PDF 一个个上传到网页工具。在 Zotero 里面直接用 @ 或者右键 Add to Chat ，就能把条目、PDF 的某几页、EPUB 章节、批注、笔记、标签、整个集合拉进同一个对话里，多篇论文一起对比之类的。 2. **引用可追溯到文本块。** 这是我最在意、也花时间最多的功能。AI 回答里给出的引用，点一下能跳回 PDF 对应页，并高亮出它引用的那个文本块； EPUB 、网页快照也是一样定位到段落。科研场景下，我觉得这个功能真是刚需。 3. **本地优先，支持 BYOK**。聊天记录存在本地 Zotero 数据库里，不上传服务器；文库的语义索引也是在本地建的。模型这边三条路随便选：自带 Key （ OpenAI 、Claude 、DeepSeek 、OpenRouter 、各种兼容接口都支持，请求直连服务商，不消耗额度）；本地模型（ Ollama 、LM Studio ，聊天和 embedding 都配成本地的就可以完全不出本机）；或者用 bibgenie 官方模型开箱即用，什么都不用配置。 4. **内置了一个 Zotero MCP Server**。这个估计 V 站的朋友会比较感兴趣。插件里直接起了个本地 MCP Server （ Streamable HTTP ，长这样：127.0.0.1:23119/bibgenie/mcp ），不用再单独装什么 Python 服务。Claude Code 、Claude Desktop 、Cursor 、Cherry Studio 连上之后，可以直接检索我的 Zotero 文库、做语义搜索、读 PDF 附件（页面还能渲染成图片，看图表和扫描页没问题）、读笔记和快照，也能在客户端自己的权限确认下建笔记、整理集合。 5. 帮着整理 Zotero 文库。 可以让它整理集合、清洗标签、核查元数据（时间长了，zotero 文献库的标签，分类之类的都乱了，可以直接来整理）。元数据是交叉比对 arXiv 、Semantic Scholar 、OpenAlex 、DBLP 、OpenReview 这几个来源的。所有改动先出一张 diff 预览卡，点批准了才写进去。 ## 关于定价 所有的功能都是免费的，需要购买的只有模型的 token 。免费用户每月送 200 credits ，Pro 是 $9.99/月，有 10000 credits （ Pro 肯定够用了!!）。现在还有个 $199 的 Lifetime Pro ，v1.0 之后会下架（当然已经买了的不受任何影响，下架只针对新购），独立开发的小产品确实长期扛不住终身制, 前期已经倒贴了不少了。 官方模型目前是通过 OpenRouter 接入的，我在成本价上只加 7% 用来覆盖服务器和其他支出，目前没打算靠 token 差价赚钱（毕竟也支持自定义模型）。 官网和文档在这： 官网： https://www.bibgenie.com 文档： https://www.bibgenie.com/docs 最后想认真求一波反馈，尤其是平时用 Zotero 的朋友。批评也完全欢迎，这东西的不少功能就是被用户骂出来的。感谢阅读。 （很抱歉，没有福利带给大家，毕竟这个产品是免费的，相信 V 友都有能力接入自定义模来使用，如果确实有想订阅的，可以留下邮箱，我给你 8 折优惠券。 当然，有 llm 服务商愿意支援 token 网页是欢迎的。）

projects.title: Show HN: Convert Anthropic and OpenAI bill exports to FinOps FOCUS (open source)
projects.author: manvshinde
projects.summary: I needed to put our Anthropic and OpenAI spend next to our cloud bills, and found that the exports don't fit together. The Claude Console gives you two CSVs. The Cost export has dollars rounded to the cent, so a day of cache reads shows $0.00. The Usage export has token counts and no dollars. Anthropic also counts input in four parts that don't overlap: uncached, cache reads, 5-minute cache writes and 1-hour cache writes, priced at 1×, 0.1×, 1.25× and 2× input. OpenAI does it differently: input_tokens already includes cached tokens. If you merge the two exports without accounting for that, you double-count or drop cached input. FOCUS is the FinOps Foundation's open billing schema. AWS, GCP and Azure already export it, but the official converters don't cover any AI provider yet. So this is a small MIT CLI: npx ai-bill-to-focus convert cost.csv usage.csv -o focus.csv --check It writes one row per day, model and token type, each with its own SKU, unit price and quantity. The dollar column is always the provider's own figure. For Anthropic, a row gets the exact token-priced amount only if that rounds to the Cost export's cents; otherwise it keep and a column says which. check runs theFinOps Foundation's validator rules, which I ported to JS, and exits non-zero on errors, so it can gate CI. Rulecan't evaluate are counted and reported, n Status: Anthropic is tested on real Consolhe cent. OpenAI and Together AI are built from their documented export formats and haven't been run on a real file yet. If you have one and it breaks, theheader row alone is enough for me to fix i Network: convert downloads a public model the request contains nothing from your files. --offline skips it, and --prices lets you supply your own list. There's also an in-browser version that doesn't upload anything: https://www.cognocient.co I work on Cognocient AI, which does this kequest (by feature, team or agent run)through a proxy. The CLI works on its own with no account. I'd especially like feedback from anyone already loading FOCUS data into a warehouse.

github.name: kennywu411-dev/honestly
github.description: Did your coding agent actually run the tests it says it ran? Blocks unverified 'done' claims in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI, and audits your history.

projects.summary: 三组公开数据：有人人工标了 150 个 Claude Code 会话，357 句"测试通过"里 80 句背后根本没跑；圣母大学等分析 20,574 个真实会话（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 都在），16,118 个失误里每 100 个就有 22 个是"没做完却说做完了"；Transluce 看了 8,600 个会话，每 55 个就有 1 个严重到"没验证的代码直接进生产"。 它不是每次骗你，是有一定概率不去检查却告诉你检查过了。轮到你头上是什么样：Codex 仓库有人提 issue，它说验证过了就部署，线上卡了五分钟，数据库连接池被打满；Claude Code 仓库有人提 issue，它说修复完成，缺陷还在线上，8,726 条记录漏掉，另一条是测试明明在报错、它回复 ALL PASSED；Cursor 论坛有人说它"浏览器里试过了"，追问才承认没开过浏览器。便宜的结局是 CI 红了回头排查，贵的是线上炸、数据漏，最糟的是后面几轮全建在这句话上，错一层叠一层。 honestly 是一个 hook：助手每写完一条回复，它读这一轮的会话记录，找出"测试通过 / 修好了 / 已推送 / 已发送 / 已部署 / 已保存 / 查过了"等 14 类结论，看最后一次改代码之后有没有对应的命令，并读命令的输出而不是退出码（pytest | tail 的退出码是 tail 的，测试全挂也是 0）。没有依据就拦下回复，要求它先跑再说；下一条回复会写明为什么被拦、补跑的结果是什么。

projects.title: Show HN: Keyward – a TUI to manage SSH keys and audit your –/.ssh security
projects.author: weiqur
projects.summary: Hi HN! Today I wanna show you a thing that solved my headache (and maybe will solve yours too). The only reason I created this tool is a mess around my SSH keys and configs. I am constantly working with a bunch of devices via SSH (such as Raspberry Pi's, VPS, handmade NAS, etc.) and I never knew whether permissions were right and there was no way to tell a strong key from a weak one. So, meet Keyward Main features: 1. Lists every key with algorithm, size, fingerprint, comment, date of last modification and whether it has a passphrase 2. Runs a security audit for all of your keys, config and permissions in ~/.ssh and grades the result with A-F score. Also here you can find fix suggestions for every problem 3. Editor for ~/.ssh/config with byte-identical round-trip so all your comments are untouched 4. Convenient key generator for those who have difficulties using the "ssh-keygen" command 5. Backup of your keys, config and encrypted metadata so u can move all of your files quickly and safely and restore them on another machine 6. Headless CLI, e.g. keyward audit --json --fail-on=warning 7. Look through your known_hosts file to see address, key type and fingerprint and delete unnecessary records Private keys are deliberately NOT encrypted by Keyward, they stay protected by their own passphrases. No daemon, no network calls, no config to learn before starting, just a single static Go binary. The security-sensitive core's direct dependencies are only filippo.io/age and golang.org/x/crypto, releases are cosign-signed. Threat model is in SECURITY.md Install: brew install gateway-of-last-resort/tap/keyward for macOS/Linux, yay -S keyward-bin for Arch Linux binary / go install for Windows I would love feedback, especially on audit checks: what SSH misconfig should it catch that it doesn't?

projects.title: Show HN: Cb2026, a Rust chess engine that revisits a 2004 world-record project
projects.author: cjus
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Carlos. In 2004 Colin Frayn and I ran ChessBrain, a distributed chess computer that played a game against GM Peter Heine Nielsen using machines volunteered from around the world. It set the Guinness World Record for the largest networked chess computer. Some ideas from that project stayed with me, so I created cb2026 (ChessBrain 2026) to explore them. cb2026 is a chess engine written from scratch in Rust. It speaks UCI and XBoard, so it runs in En Croissant, Cute Chess, XBoard and similar GUIs. It has Lazy SMP search, Syzygy tablebase probing, Polyglot opening books, Chess960, and an NNUE evaluation network trained on its own games. Strength: about 3379 ± 21 on the CCRL Blitz scale, from 5,600 games against seven rated engines. Its original hand-crafted evaluation rated 2782, and each NNUE generation improved on that. I wanted it to be easy to learn from as well as strong: - Every technique can be switched off. An interactive shell lets you play it, watch it think depth by depth, and toggle things like null-move pruning to see what each one does. - docs/elo-ledger.md records how much Elo each technique gained. - A companion book, "Building a Chess Engine in Rust", has a chapter for each stage, from board representation and move generation to NNUE. Each chapter covers the idea, the real code and what it measured. It's free online, as a PDF or as an EPUB: https://cjus.github.io/chessengine/ It also has strength levels that blunder about as often as Lichess players of a given rating do. License is MIT or Apache-2.0. The one exception: release binaries include Syzygy probing through a GPL-3.0 crate, which makes those binaries GPL. Build with --no-default-features to get a binary with no GPL code. Happy to answer questions about the engine, the book, or ChessBrain.

projects.summary: We’re happy to introduce Artificer, our first robotics decision model for evaluating robot task progress and success. The problem Robot systems need feedback during training, evaluation, and deployment. An arm might grasp the right object, but place it in the wrong bin. A robot might’ve only completed part of its task before it stopped. Assessing these outcomes from video often requires manual review or brittle, handcrafted objectives. Though frontier models do well in evaluation, they are expensive and slow. Artificer is a 4B parameter model that estimates task completion and progress, at the frontier level, from a task description and video. During deployment, these estimates provide feedback to a robot controller to help decide whether to continue an attempt, retry, or move to the next task. Know a robotics team working on task evaluation or success detection? We'd appreciate an introduction! For the robotics founders: we’d love to test Artificer on your task videos! Would love to chat more in the comments or over email! sunny@trynua.dev

projects.title: Show HN: Dbprint – Database Context for Agents
projects.author: jakubro
projects.summary: CLI that produces an offline snapshot of a database (DDL, column- and relation-level statistics, values with frequencies), combines it with annotations written by you or an agent, and exposes it as MCP and as a web UI. Works with PG, MySQL, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Databricks, BigQuery. How to try it: uvx dbprint context \ arboretum.seedbank.germination_trial \ --purpose query \ --project https://github.com/jakubro/dbprint/blob/main/docs/format/v1/examples/production/.dbprint.yaml Features: - Philosophy: snapshots are meant to sit next to your code and versioned so that you have a history of changes and agents can hit them when searching codebase. - Offline: no need to expose live credentials to agents. - CI: "dbprint check" can verify schema/data drift. - Annotations: complement statistics by documenting the meaning behind data. An agent can prepare them for you ("dbprint annotate"). - Redaction: values can be masked/excluded/hashed either explicitly with FQNs or automatically based on inferred sensitivity and value shape. - Format: Snapshots are YAML and markdown, so greppable and usable by other tools. Why I built this: SQL queries produced by agents were inaccurate, and the overall time to result was slow and costly because of finding the answers in codebase or in live database.

projects.title: 因为忍受不了兄弟打印机手机打印的锯齿和 Word 变字体，我手搓了套 600/1200DPI 1-Bit 点阵渲染引擎 + 免费多端远程打印网关
projects.author: ptervip
projects.summary: 各位 V 友大家好，我是独立开发者。 家里买过 **兄弟（ Brother DCP-B7520DW / B7535DW / T420W / T720DW / L2535DW /L1848W 等）**，或者惠普、佳能、爱普生、奔图无线打印机的朋友，大概率都被以下三个问题折磨过： 1. **手机打出来的字远不如电脑清楚（严重锯齿、笔画发虚）**：明明同一台激光/喷墨打印机，用电脑插 USB 线打出来字迹如刀刻般锐利；但一换到手机官方 App （比如 `Brother iPrint&Scan`）、微信小程序或者安卓系统默认打印服务，打出来的汉字边缘全是阶梯状马赛克锯齿，细横画断裂发虚，小字甚至糊成一团。 2. **手机直接打 Word (`.docx`) 必定变字体、乱排版**：电脑上排得好好的宋体、楷体、仿宋、小标宋公文或数学试卷，传到手机微信里直接打开打印，全部被迫坍塌成同一种无衬线黑体，粗体黏连、行距错位、莫名其妙多出一页空白。 3. **异地远程打印配置太劝退**：人在公司上班或出差，老师在群里发了卷子要打，家里老人不会弄。如果在软路由或 NAS 上折腾 CUPS + 找 Linux 驱动 + 配 frp/Tailscale 内网穿透，不仅步骤繁琐，家里人的手机还得跟着挂穿透客户端，体验非常割裂。 一怒之下，我耗时几个月手搓了这套 **「鹰眼打印 (HawkEye Print)」** —— 把**原生 600/1200 DPI 1-Bit 激光点阵渲染引擎**、**30 款 Windows 原版字库**和**免公网 IP 的多平台远程打印网关**装进了手机里。 - 🌐 **官方网站 & 全平台网关直下**： https://yingyandayin.com/ --- ### 一、 底层技术拆解：我是怎么根治“锯齿发虚”和“Word 变字体”的？ #### 1. 绕过系统 150~300 DPI 灰度缩水，原生 600/1200 DPI 1-Bit 点阵流直驱 为什么普通手机打印会发虚有锯齿？ 因为安卓默认打印框架与大多数小程序在发送任务时，会先将页面光栅化缩水成 **150~300 DPI 的 RGB/灰度位图**，打印机收到低清灰度图后再做二次**半色调网点抖动（ Halftone Dithering ）**——原本应该 100% 纯黑落粉的笔画边缘，全变成了散落的灰点与马赛克阶梯。 **鹰眼打印的做法**： - 彻底绕过系统低清打印转换管线，直接在手机本地以 **原生 600 DPI / 1200 DPI** 进行超高清矢量光栅化； - 通过自适应二值化阈值算法，直接生成 **1-Bit 纯血激光像素点阵流（ PJL / PCL / Raster ）**，通过局域网 `RAW (9100)` 或 `IPP (631)` 端口直驱打印机； - 打印机不再做任何二次灰阶抖动，落纸效果与电脑插 USB 数据线直连 **100% 完全一致**。App 内置了「彩色原稿 / 黑白二值化实效」双模切换，打印前可以直接在手机上无极放大 10 倍检查每一根笔画的像素边缘。 #### 2. 自研 Word 矢量排版引擎 + 30 款 Windows 原版字体按需秒配（ 100% 本地解析零上传） 普通安卓手机系统只内置了单一的无衬线黑体（`DroidSansFallback` / `NotoSansCJK`），缺少电脑 Windows 上的常用字库。 **鹰眼打印的做法**： - 内置自研的 `.docx` 矢量排版解析引擎，文档 **100% 在手机本地解析渲染（零上传云端服务器，绝不泄露合同、公文与试卷隐私）**； - 当解析到文档使用了手机缺失的字体（如 **宋体、楷体、仿宋_GB2312 、方正小标宋、黑体、微软雅黑、等线、华文行楷、Times New Roman 、Cambria Math 数学公式** 等 30 款 Windows 原版字重）时，仅从云端毫秒级按需拉取对应的轻量字体包并永久缓存到本地； - 真正实现页边距、字间距、行距、中西文混排与真粗体的 **1:1 电脑级还原**。 --- ### 二、100% 永久免费的四大「家中远程打印网关」（无需公网 IP · 免配内网穿透） 为了解决在外地用 4G/5G 远程控制家里打印机的问题，我把**「家中打印网关」做成了 100% 永久免费、不限时长、不限接收页数**，无需公网 IP ，也不用装任何 VPN ，只需记下网关生成的 **6 位数字配对码**，外地手机输码即可秒连出纸（首次连上后自动记忆，下次点一下 3 秒出纸）： 1. **🛜 OpenWrt / iStoreOS 软路由插件（ 365 天×24 小时零功耗值守）** - 提供了全架构通用的 `luci-app-hawkeye-gateway_1.2.6-1_all.ipk`（ x86 / ARM 均可用，体积小巧，彻底告别臃肿的 CUPS ）； - 上传 ipk 安装后，在 LuCI ` [服务] -> [鹰眼打印] ` 勾选启用，填入打印机局域网 IP （如 `192.168.1.150`），即可看到 6 位配对码。 2. **🗄️ 群晖 Synology / 飞牛 fnOS / 绿联等 NAS 部署（ 24 小时无人值守）** - **群晖免 Docker 10 秒部署法（最稳最快）**：无需折腾 Docker 镜像源！解压 `hawkeye-gateway-nas.zip` 到 NAS 后，直接在群晖 ` [控制面板] -> [任务计划] ` 新增一条 `root` 自定义脚本运行即可： ```bash nohup python3 /volume1/docker/hawkeye/lasersharp_gateway.py --headless --web-port 19180 >/dev/null 2>&1 & ``` - **飞牛 fnOS / Docker Compose 部署法**：打开飞牛 ` [ Docker ] -> [ Compose ] -> [新增项目] ` 选中解压目录即可一键启动； - 部署后浏览器访问 `http://你的 NAS_IP:19180` 即可打开可视化 Web 控制台查看 6 位配对码并绑定打印机 IP 。 3. **💻 Windows / Mac 电脑一键网关** - 下载解压 `hawkeye-gateway-pc.zip`，Windows 提供 `Windows 后台静默运行(无黑框).vbs`（可丢进 `shell:startup` 开机无感自启），Mac 双击 `.command` 即可运行。 4. **📱 家里闲置旧安卓机 / 长辈手机直接当网关（零硬件门槛）** - 家里淘汰的旧安卓手机（ Android 7.0~15 均可）装上鹰眼打印 App ，切到 `「🏠 作为家中网关」` 页面放着，就能免费充当打印网关。 三、 针对打试卷与日常办公的几个顺手功能 🧹 拍照试卷一键净白去底灰 & 剥离斜向水印：手机拍下来的试卷常有阴影黑边或机构彩色斜水印，开启「去水印 / 防粘连 / 加深」与「红黑双色分离」档位，自动剥离底灰，省墨不卡纸。 📘 单面打印机「手动双面打印傻瓜向导」：家里的单面机想打双面？软件会自动先打完全部奇数页 -> 弹出直观的翻纸方向图解 -> 点击继续后自动按 [逆序] 打印偶数页，打完直接装订，再也不用动脑猜正反面和页码顺序。 🖨️ 广泛兼容主流机型： 兄弟（ Brother ）全系：DCP-T420W/T425W/T426W 、DCP-T720DW/T725DW 、DCP-T820DW 、MFC-T920DW 、DCP-B7520DW/B7535DW 、HL-B2080DW 、DCP-L2535DW/L2550DW 、HL-L2350DW 、MFC-L2710DW 等； 其他主流品牌：支持 IPP (631) 或 RAW (9100) 协议的惠普（ HP ）、佳能（ Canon ）、爱普生（ Epson ）、奔图（ Pantum ）、联想、施乐、京瓷等 Wi-Fi / 局域网打印机。 四、 关于免费额度与 V 友专属福利 🎁 永久免费部分：所有平台的「家中远程打印网关」 100% 永久免费；每台手机每天赠送 局域网免费 3 页 + 新机赠送 远程打印免费 10 页（足够大家完整测试打印机连接、对比 1200DPI 刀刻画质与异地出纸效果）。 Pro 会员定价：觉得确实解决了痛点再考虑支持，年付仅 ¥12/年，永久买断 ¥29.9 ~ ¥59.9 （一机一码硬件级绑定，卸载重装联网 1 秒自动恢复会员）。 🎉 V2EX 专属送码福利： 非常感谢大家帮我测试各种品牌的打印机与 NAS/软路由环境！ 回帖留下你的 [打印机型号 + 准备用什么设备当网关（如飞牛/群晖/OpenWrt/旧手机）] ，并附上 App 会员中心显示的 [ 10 位本机设备码（如 8F3A9-C12B4 ）] ，前 100 层楼我直接后台为你免费激活 Pro 会员！ 🌐 官网地址（含 APK / NAS 包 / OpenWrt ipk / PC 网关直下）： https://yingyandayin.com/

projects.summary: I've been fine tuning my own decision models lately and I've been interested in how there are no real multi-turn harnesses out there for decision models. I decided to build my own. The standard claude code style interface doesn't quite make sense with a decision model since it isn't a conversation so I built this out as a sort-of REPL inspired interface. You can also use it with the command line. You just type facts as you get them and ask questions with a ?. The questions stick around so every new fact gets asked again and you can see the probabilities move. You can use this to chain together different series of decisions to power decision networks and graphs with nouli. You can bring your own Typesafe, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or local model to run with it. projects.title: Show HN: Backend for Agents and Builders who don't need one yet – Statebase
projects.author: bhldev
projects.summary: 100% Meat Machine Post, handcrafted for you (I personally typed in the emdash)! site: < https://statebase.dev > quickstart: < https://statebase.dev/docs/quickstart > examples: < https://statebase.dev/apps > < https://statebase.dev/games > < https://statebase.dev/examples > arch: < https://statebase.dev/arch > dsl: < https://statebase.dev/dsl > Hi everyone, I'm Brian. I like frontend a lot. I can do backend, but not every little thing is worth it and I've been making "detached" HTML apps (not even needing a web server) as long as I can remember. I wanted a way to standup some sort of secure way to save data, maybe with a little bit of logic with just a few commands. I didn't want code (TypeScript, Java, C#, etc), but I also didn't want no code either -- maybe it's the devops in me (Terraform?). I was done waiting, and made this. It hosts the logic, permissions and state you need for an agent, application or game with pure curl commands. Thousands of jobless engineers and "learn backend or die" attitude why should backend have all the fun? Besides this might be good for scripting and infrastructure setup too, so it has something for everyone. There's also a Tauri+pglite version for desktop dev (thank you pglite) and a Devvit template for Reddit games (I made a couple, ask) all running on the same engine. Please give it a shot, and if you like what you see join my team (I got tired of working on it alone so I added a childhood friend and a few ex-coworkers) and I in our Discord. I'm full time on it now so any feedback even negative is more fuel. If it sucks, we want to know about it, so we can make it better. Now for the big questions *Is it Open Source?* Not yet. There's a lot of reasons but the main one is the code is in a giant monorepo that has to be cleaned up. Another reason is I eventually want to make it Fair Source or Open Core, so that a hyperscaler can't just wrap it and charge everyone (including me) a lot of money just to use it. We do have to charge money for serious production use. *What if you disappear tomorrow?* Absolutely valid question. That's why I put a lot of effort into the export to SQL (eject) functionality. It's not perfect yet, but you can export all the logic and permissions into your own Postgres database. So if you want to run it 100% standalone from Statebase, you can. The SQL export generates is ugly for now; a lot has to do with nulls. We will improve it but I wanted to avoid forcing a schema to start. *AI Support?* MCP is coming very soon (next few days) and x402 payments is in the works. But I wanted to get it in the hands of flesh and bone, to see if it really excites someone as much as it does me. I know it's possible the vast majority of users will be agents, but hoping for at least a few flesh and blood champions. *Plans?* It's built on Cloudflare Durable Objects for cost savings and other advantages like built-in tenant isolation and native websockets (honestly scary how well DO mapped to our needs). But it could exist anywhere. We have a node version, a desktop version (Tauri+pglite), a devvit version (Reddit games) and so on. My dream is for this to get big, very big, so anyone making a prototype experiment, throwaway or even basic production loads reach for this. We also want to hold a game jam as soon as possible and eventually I want to make one-click installer plugins for Phaser, Unity, Godot and so on. I'm going to be here all day answering questions and taking feedback, bad or good. Whatever happens, I'm going to be building with it my entire life. It just "feels" right to me. Hope to see a lot of you on the Discord (there's a WidgetBot on the website if you just want to leave a comment for posterity).

projects.summary: 3z9wOpt（无名大叔系统优化工具箱）—— 一款免安装的 Windows 系统优化清理工具。 Go + Wails v2 写的单文件绿色版，15MB，解压双击就跑，不需要安装。 一款能清垃圾、优化系统、查硬件、管理启动项、查磁盘空间占用、分析蓝屏——等 10 个模块， 外加 34 个系统原生小工具（SFC / DISM / 网络修复 / 引导修复等）的小巧好用的软件。 几个我觉得值得一看的点： 数据真读本机，读不到的字段界面上就写「读不到」，不编造。驱动管理里也不写 「有 N 个驱动可更新」那样需要逐家官网核实才能说的话。 改了能拨回来：启动项禁用写的是系统 StartupApproved 审批位，而不是删注册表 Run 键值， 154 项优化每一条都能单独还原。 磁盘占用直读 NTFS 的 MFT 索引，全盘几秒出结果，不是遍历目录。 不联网、不留后台，GPLv3 开源。 作者是做电脑远程维修的，这个项目今年从闭源转成了开源。 目前只支持 Windows 10/11（依赖 WebView2），不支持 ARM64。 （作者本人投稿）

projects.summary: openhongguo 是红果短剧的非官方 SDK，Apache-2.0 许可证。它用一台匿名设备发请求，不需要登录，可以浏览书城频道、搜索短剧、读取短剧和分集详情、查看排行榜和演员主页，并取得分集的播放地址。 红果 App 的数据接口它基本都包了，所以可以拿它开发一个自定义的红果客户端，界面和交互都由你决定： 用 Flutter 或 React Native 写一个移动端 App，按自己的喜好重新设计首页、搜索和播放页 用 Swift 做 macOS 原生客户端，或者用 Node.js / Go 做网页版、电视端、命令行版 只取自己需要的功能：比如只看追更的几部剧、按演员订阅新作、做一个榜单聚合页 仓库自带的命令行程序 ohg 就是一个这样的例子：在终端里搜剧、选集，然后用 mpv 播放。 主要特点： 一套 Go 实现，编译出六个平台的包：Go、Node.js（npm）、Android（Maven Central）、iOS / macOS（Swift Package）、React Native、Flutter（pub.dev）。各语言的方法一一对应，行为相同。 第一次请求时自动注册匿名设备，设备档案可以存文件、存内存，或自己实现存储。 错误都有统一的错误码和“是否可重试”标记，限流、网络失败和 5xx 自动重试。 分页接口附带 Pager，自动去掉服务端跨页返回的重复短剧。 服务端接口没有公开文档，仓库每天跑一次接口契约检查，尽早发现改版。 Go 版快速上手： go client, := adapters.NewClient("anonymous.json", sdk.Options{}) page, := client.Search(ctx, "全球死考", sdk.SearchOptions{}) episodes, := client.ListEpisodes(ctx, page.Items[0].ID, sdk.EpisodeOptions{}) pb, := client.ResolvePlayback(ctx, episodes.Items[0].ID, sdk.PlaybackOptions{}) Node.js 版：npm install openhongguo，然后 const client = await createClient(); await client.search('全球死考'); 本项目仅供学习移动应用接口协议的分析与调用，禁止商业使用和大规模采集，短剧内容的版权归原权利人所有。

projects.author: yidinghe
projects.summary: 本人二十年后端开发和架构经验，对 coding agent 的要求就是稳、准、慎三个字。我现在的 AI 工具搭建很简单，就是先装一个 pi ，里面装一个记忆插件（尝试过一些，最后选择用 Magic-Context ），然后配置一个全局的系统提示词。就这些。然后我用的模型就是各类 flash 模型，最便宜的。我一直专注于把最便宜的模型用到极致。 要想把最便宜的模型用好，系统提示词很重要，它决定了 agent 的思考风格和基调。我们是小公司，没有测试环境，没有测试流程，改完了就上线。我的 pi 是可以直接访问生产环境的，但凡出现报错日志，我只要粘贴日志内容，然后说“分析一下原因”，agent 就会翻日志、翻代码、翻数据库，翻配置文件，最后把横跨多个数据库和多个模块调用的来龙去脉讲清楚，最后还给出建议。 总之，就我的体验，这套提示词配合项目具体的 skill ，我用起来还是比较满意的。我现在唯一不让 agent 做的就是数据库修改操作。 提示词大小 7K 左右，具体内容 https://gist.github.com/yiding-he/9d02d5bba749a854ac1bfe75769619d5 希望对大家有用。

projects.title: 因为受够了手动更新 IIS 证书，我花了半年时间做了一个自动托管平台，想听听大家的意见
projects.author: netlichun
projects.summary: 作为一个独立开发者，我平时会做一些小项目，其中主要是 Web 项目，也有时候会接点小活，帮客户做一些小网站。这些网站基本上都是使用阿里云或腾讯云的云服务器进行部署，因为现在的浏览器对于 SSL 证书的要求越来越严格，所以基本每个站点都要部署 SSL 证书，这在前几年也不是个事，因为阿里云和腾讯云都提供免费的一年期证书，每隔一年部署一次，也还能承受。 但是最近几年越来越吃力，阿里云和腾讯云的免费证书，都开始减少有效期，一开始从一年减到 6 个月，还勉强凑合用，后来减到 3 个月，就感觉有点顾不过来了，因为虽然免费，但每个证书都要申请、下载、导入到证书管理、绑定到 IIS……站点多了，操作还是挺繁琐的。三个月就到期，经常会忘记更新证书，导致网站打开就是大大的风险提示，有时候还是客户发现了告诉我，我才知道。 虽然这两家都还提供一年期的证书，但是那价格，我确实有点难以承受。 后来我就开始研究证书这个事，才发现其实可以从第三方申请免费的证书，比如 Let's Encrypt ，我也了解到 win-acme 这类成熟的开源工具，它本身就能够实现 IIS 证书自动申请和续期。不过我个人更习惯图形化管理，而且有时候需要维护多台服务器上的多个网站，希望能通过一个 Web 工作台统一查看证书状态、集中管理部署目标，而不是分别登录每台服务器进行配置和维护。所以现有工具虽然不错，但还是没能完全满足我自己的使用习惯。 国内也找到了一些提供证书自动化服务的平台，不过我试用之后感觉，大部分还是更偏向 Linux 、Nginx 等环境，或者需要通过脚本进行部署，与我平时使用 Windows Server + IIS 的习惯不太一致。 就有了自己开发一个工具的想法，并且我研究了一下发现，这个技术条件还很现成，Let's Encrypt 提供了一个叫做 ACME 的协议，可以通过编程的方式自动申请证书，这不就正好可以发挥咱程序员的特长嘛，于是开始着手鼓捣这个东西。做的过程中，我又觉得这个东西可以搞成一个平台，比搞个单机版工具更有价值，因为单机版工具，还是需要远程到服务器上维护，搞一个平台，可以在浏览器上操作，并且把多台服务器集中到统一界面来管理。不但可以解决我的问题，我还可以把这个做成一个 Saas ，帮别人解决问题，同时自己也能有点小收益。 经过了小半年的产品设计以及开发，各种反复尝试与推倒重来，我终于把这个产品做出来了，这就是现在我要隆重推介给大家的：SSLThink - IIS 网站证书托管与自动化部署平台，鼓掌！！！ 网址： https://www.sslthink.com 平台的主要功能，就是帮你申请 Let's Encrypt 证书，以及把证书部署到 IIS 网站。当然，平台干了这个活，也适当收点辛苦费。目前是公测期，每张证书的价格是 10 元/年，当然说「每张证书」不够严谨，这个价格其实是一年的证书订阅费用，在订阅期内，证书会自动更新。目前 Let's Encrypt 的证书有效期是 90 天，而且未来还会进一步缩短到 64 天、45 天。也就是说，证书更新会越来越频繁。不过对于 SSLThink 用户来说，这些更新由平台按照证书实际有效期自动处理，不需要手动重新申请和部署。 有同学就问了，Let's Encrypt 证书不是免费的嘛，你怎么还收费呢？其实收费的不是证书本身，而是 SSLThink 围绕证书搭建了一整套自动签发、自动更新、自动部署的全流程体系，如果你的网站用的是 IIS ，那么购买了这一年的证书订阅服务，进行初始的配置之后，往后你就不用操心证书这回事了，然后一年到期之后你再续订，那就继续不用操心，也不用重新配置。 具体怎么实现的呢？证书的签发与更新，是在 SSLThink 的服务端进行的，这个自然不在话下。在域名验证方面，SSLThink 采用的是 ACME 协议中的 DNS-01 验证方式。我把这部分也自动化了，用户只需要按照平台提供的记录，初始配置一次 CNAME 委托，之后证书签发和更新所需的 DNS 验证就由 SSLThink 自动处理，不需要每次更新时再去修改 DNS 记录。 关键是证书的部署，我开发了一个「托管节点程序」，把这个托管节点程序安装到 Windows 服务器，它会自动同步你的 IIS 站点和 https 绑定信息到 Web 工作台，然后在工作台对相应站点的 https 绑定与你购买的证书进行关联绑定，这个托管节点程序就会自动帮你把证书部署好，并且之后服务端的证书更新了，它也会自动更新 IIS 上对应的证书。 考虑到很多使用 IIS 部署网站的同学，除了网站，还有可能会使用一些云服务产品，比如 CDN 、阿里云的 OSS 等，这些云产品往往也有部署证书的需求，既然网站的证书都自动化了，没道理还要手动再搞这些云产品的部署，好在阿里云和腾讯云都提供了给云产品部署证书的接口，所以 SSLThink 的证书还可以自动部署到阿里云和腾讯云的一些云产品上，当然这个还是需要一些初始配置以及授权，具体的操作我都整理了详细的帮助文档，根据文档一步一步来就行，并不复杂。并且，如果你没有使用 IIS ，只是需要用 SSLThink 进行阿里云和腾讯云的云产品自动部署，那就无需安装 Windows 托管节点程序。 如果对于同时管理多台服务器，以及多个网站的同学，SSLThink 的价值体现就更大了，因为可以直接从 Web 工作台，就可以全局随时查看证书的更新和部署情况，如果哪个证书有问题，平台还会及时发送消息提醒。 当然，目前这个平台的自动部署功能主要围绕 Windows Server + IIS 环境设计，暂时不支持 Linux 、Nginx 或宝塔面板等环境的自动部署。不过通过平台签发的证书仍然可以下载，手动部署到其他支持的服务器环境。 另外提前说明一下：SSLThink 的托管节点是需要安装在 Windows Server 上的程序，目前安装包已经使用 Certum 企业代码签名证书完成数字签名，并且带有可信时间戳，签名发布者为济南善思信息科技有限公司。由于软件刚刚发布、下载量较少，如果使用微软的 Edge 浏览器下载，可能仍会遇到 SmartScreen 信誉提示。官网下载页面提供了 SHA-256 校验值，大家可以自行核对安装包的来源和数字签名。 由于程序需要操作 IIS 证书和 HTTPS Binding ，我知道大家可能会对安装第三方程序有顾虑。如果有关于权限、安全边界或运行机制的问题，也欢迎直接提出，我会尽量解释清楚。 最后也想听听各位同学们的真实意见：现在还有多少人在用 Windows Server + IIS 部署网站？大家平时是怎么解决 SSL 证书自动续期和部署问题的？ 我知道 win-acme 等免费工具已经可以很好地解决不少场景，所以也挺想了解，对于需要管理多台服务器、多个网站的用户，像 SSLThink 这种集中托管的平台到底有没有价值。 这是我第一次认真把一个自用工具做成 SaaS ，目前才刚上线，还没有经过多少真实用户的检验。欢迎大家拍砖，尤其是对功能、安全性和收费模式有什么建议，我都很愿意听听。

projects.title: 【项目自荐】VaultMesh：本地优先的跨平台密码管理器，为 AI Agent 提供 SSH 能力而不暴露私钥
projects.author: JsonLee12138
projects.summary: VaultMesh 是一个多端支持、本地优先（Local-First）的个人密码与凭据管理器，支持 macOS、Windows、Android 以及 Chrome / Firefox 浏览器扩展。 它没有云端账号、没有中央服务器，加密数据库（Vault）仅存储在用户自己的设备上。除常规的网站凭据、TOTP、SSH 密钥和局域网 P2P 同步外，VaultMesh 针对当前开发者深度使用 AI Agent 的场景，提出了 “只给能力，不给凭据（Capabilities, not Credentials）” 的 Agent 能力代理机制。 为什么做这个项目？解决的痛点 1. 摆脱云端束缚与数据泄露隐忧： 许多主流密码管理工具依赖远端云服务。VaultMesh 坚持 Local-First，底层加解密与核心逻辑全部由共享的 Rust core 驱动，跨设备同步仅在受信任的局域网内双向传输密文，无云端中转与后门。 2. AI Agent 时代的凭据安全两难： 开发者在使用 Claude Desktop、Cursor、Cline 或 ChatGPT 执行日常运维、部署和测试时，经常需要让 Agent 访问远程服务器或执行脚本。直接将私钥、明文密码贴进 Prompt 或配置到环境变量中，极易造成私钥外泄或记录在第三方模型日志中。 为此，VaultMesh 实现了基于标准 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的 Agent Capability Broker： 零私钥暴露：Agent 不直接接触私钥文件，而是向本地 VaultMesh 申请一次短时（如 15 分钟）的 OpenSSH Agent 会话； 系统原生生物识别：调用时触发宿主机原生 Touch ID / 密码认证弹窗； 原生协议与零环境侵入：本地生成单会话独占的 Unix Socket，支持 ssh、rsync、git 等所有原生工具链，私钥仅在 Rust 内存中完成签名，操作完成或超时后即刻安全销毁。 核心特性 多凭据聚合：卡片式管理网站登录、SSH 凭据、支付卡、身份信息与开发者 API 密钥。 局域网双向同步：配对设备在同一 Wi-Fi 内自动发现与安全同步，锁定时只传输密文。 浏览器扩展联动：Chrome / Firefox 扩展作为受控轻量代理，不持久化 Vault，支持安全填充。 短时 SSH-Agent 桥接（亮点）：让 AI Agent 安全免密操作远程服务器，私钥全程不落盘、不入上下文。

projects.author: lumifloracc
projects.summary: aidesign 是一个 AI 界面设计工具。输入自然语言需求，生成多页面、logo、海报、带结构化图层的 Web UI，生成后可以逐层修改、交互，也可以继续用对话调整当前页面和导出react、vue、html以及将所有设计页面导出为一整个可运行的项目代码。 下面为一段两分钟的演示视频，使用的模型为deepseek -v4-pro和deepseek-v4.1-flash 核心特性： 从一句需求生成整套多页面 UI，不是单张效果图 设计 Token 变量绑定与一致性检查 对话式修改当前页面，不需要从头重新生成，支持某一页，某一处细节ai修改，且支持直接代码修改，然后实时预览生效 降低体验门槛： 不需要注册，项目数据存在浏览器本地。不配置 API Key 也能用内置 Mock 生成器走一遍“需求→生成→编辑”的完整流程。 适用场景： SaaS 后台、数据看板、企业官网落地页、移动端 H5、内部工具的高保真原型探索，想快速将想法生成为一个demo的用户。 当前限制： 暂不支持自部署模型，只支持公网可直连的 OpenAI 兼容公网端点。

projects.title: [开源自荐] 小清：按工具识别剪辑软件和 AI 工具缓存的 Mac 清理工具
projects.author: chenmozhe008

github.name: chenmozhe008/qingo
github.description: 面向影视创作者与开发者的 Mac 清理工具。识别 60 余款剪辑、设计与 AI 工具的缓存，一键清理，可撤销，不影响项目、素材与对话。

projects.summary: 小清是用 SwiftUI 写的 macOS 清理工具，针对做视频和写代码的人。剪映、达芬奇、AE 和 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 这类工具都会在 ~/Library 里堆积大量文件，但同一个目录里往往既有可以重建的缓存，也有项目草稿和对话记录。小清为 60 余款工具逐个写了识别规则，只把确定能自动重建的部分列出来，一键移到废纸篓。 亮点 1. 规则集中在 CreativeApps.swift：每个工具区分「只统计不清理」的目录和「可清理」的缓存目录，拿不准的路径只能放进前者，新增工具照此提交 PR 2. 清理前再次核对文件身份，变化了就跳过；只移到废纸篓，结果条上可以一键撤销放回原处 3. 不扫描沙盒容器（避免触发系统授权弹窗），不跟随符号链接，不跨卷；.ssh、.aws 等凭据目录始终受保护 4. 另有「开发缓存」页，按项目列出 ~/Coding 等代码目录下的构建缓存；还带一个按 bundle id 精确匹配残留文件的应用卸载工具 5. 不包含网络请求代码，扫描结果只存在本机；支持 macOS 26 液态玻璃效果

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Gear：打造 RSI 领域的 scikit-learn
projects.author: YehuiTang0316
projects.summary: 读了一堆 RSI（递归自我改进）论文，感觉绕来绕去，还是 RL 和进化搜索里的几个老问题： 1. Sampling：怎么高效地找到值得尝试的改动？ 2. 评测：怎么判断新 variant 真的变好了？ 3. 多样性：怎么避免过早收敛，越进化路越窄？ 这些方法不全是 RL，但换成“自进化”的名字，也没让这些问题消失。 所以我们做了 Gear。框架采用受 Meta-learning 启发的双层结构：内层 Agent 执行任务、产生轨迹；外层 Meta Agent 根据轨迹和评测反馈，改进提示词、工具、工作流和上下文管理。 我们将搜索决策与执行、评测流程分离，想做 RSI 领域的 scikit-learn，让 GEPA、RRSI、Harness² 这类算法更容易实现和比较。目前已经实现了一个包含共享失败诊断和分阶段评测的 GEPA 变体。 固定使用 GPT 5.6 Luna、medium 推理档位，任务通过率如下： | 任务集 | 原始 DSH | Gear 优化后的 DSH | | --- | ---: | ---: | | AutomationBench Marketing | 27.0% | 40.0% | | AutomationBench Support | 17.0% | 25.0% | | Terminal-Bench 2.1 | 52.8% | 62.9% | 在 Marketing 的 max 档评测中，Luna + 优化后的 DSH 达到 88.88% 的目标完成率，高于 Astra + Codex 的 84.08%。不过，严格任务通过率是 53% 对 57%，优势体现在部分目标完成度上。 另外，两种模型同用优化后的 DSH、同为 max 档时，Luna 单任务 API 等价费用估算为 0.0568 美元，Astra 为 1.1858 美元，低约 95%，不含优化和基础设施开销。

projects.title: Show HN: Potential conversation partners in Bluesky using agentic search
projects.author: wolecki
projects.summary: What if instead of talking to AI, we could find human counterparts currently sharing the same interest to talk to? Some whales kind of do that by singing across the ocean. This inspired a thought process for a conceptual social network - whalesong - where an idea, thought or a conversationally valuable statement could be matched on. In contrast with the wide-broadcast social network visibility (restricted on groups or connections), I’d love to explore the idea of context-based networking. This experiment is showcasing the technical feasibility and potential value in whalesong. The goal: uncover conversational counterparts among Bluesky posts using an agentic search algorithm. The setup: a one-week window of bluesky posts with some filtering (e.g. mostly text, no promotions or reposts/comments), indexed in a postgres database. A curated seed set - an agentic process defines a conversation-seeking cohort by creating some heuristic queries, iterating and validating it on retrieved data and resulting in a non-exhaustive set of high-quality data points. Counterpart retrieval - for a seed conversation-seeking post, an agentic process generates search queries, runs them against the database and retrieves potential matches. It reviews retrievals and iterates on improving or expanding the search. Out of several configurations, the best performing agentic setup (bespoke mini-harness with Gemini Argon - low) managed to find meaningful matches to 79% of a sample set of 100 seeds. This setup consumed on average 42K input tokens on each match search, of which 56.8% were cached, output token count was negligible. So this experiment made it clearer to me that technology is not the blocker for a “whalesong” experience. This leads me to further investigate the experience itself. Would love to hear from you folks about experiences in getting in touch with a complete stranger on the web because both of you asked the same question or had a similar problem to solve. What made you connect? Where did it happen? Did finding similarity make connecting easy?

projects.title: Show HN: I built a tool that finds reliability bugs in your code
projects.author: aray07
projects.summary: Hey HN, I’m Abhishek. I'm building Opslane, a tool that finds reliability issues in your code. On every PR, it spins up your entire app and then tries to find weak spots that would break in production. Demo: https://youtu.be/47phxkdh6f0 Example: We tested Opslane on Lago (open-source billing) and found a bug where customers get double charged. Opslane made Stripe take the money and then return a 500. Lago marked the payment failed. A retry from the dashboard charged the customer again. https://github.com/getlago/lago-api/issues/6903 Why I built this I used to work on reliability at Robinhood. We used to run chaos testing in our staging environments: inject faults in various parts of the system and see what breaks. We found issues like Kafka or Redis being unavailable for a few seconds could take the whole app down. But that kind of testing was expensive. It needed a well maintained staging environment. Engineers needed to know what to test. Most teams never actually did it. Over the last year, coding agents have gone writing some of my code to almost all my code now. Teams are shipping way more code than they were 6 months ago. Code review tools read the diff, but a lot of reliability bugs aren't in the diff. They're in how your code behaves when Stripe, Redis or the network misbehaves. And e2e tests usually mock those services out and test the happy path. Agents have made this type of testing a lot cheaper. And we will see more of this (kinda like security scanning / testing) How it works A full copy of your app per PR: Postgres, Redis, Kafka, SQS, S3. Working copies of your third-party dependencies: Stripe, Slack, Gmail and more. Traffic goes through our proxy, which lets us inject failures. The agent picks what to test: It reads every PR and writes down invariants that need to hold (for e.g. a customer should never be charged twice). It then injects faults likely to break the invariants. Bugs we've found We ran Opslane on some popular open-source apps and here are some of the bugs we have found: 1/ Twenty: deleting a workspace while Stripe is failing locks everyone out, and billing keeps going. Twenty merged a fix. ( https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/issues/28043 ) 2/ Dub: a restart in the middle of a payout paid a partner $240 for $120 owed. ( https://github.com/dubinc/dub.link/issues/4707 ) Full list: opslane.com/open-source Opslane is pretty early - we have a couple of early customers. We have found bugs in their system that their other code review tools missed. Would love to get feedback from folks and how they are seeing the reliability of their systems evolve over time with agents.

projects.title: Show HN: Muscle Memory – Can you still write code without AI?
projects.author: ekkuleivonen
projects.summary: Developer of 6 years here, been using AI (increasingly) over the last year for most of my work. A few weeks back I started to look for new jobs as the current startup I work for is falling into pieces. "Do I need to do leetcode again?" - I thought. So I picked a few challenges and tried to solve them without an assistant. This felt impossible. What?! Is this the brainrot everyone is talking about? I mean I still read code every day, I just don't write it anymore. I could read and review the solution easily, but writing it myself felt like speaking a language I only understand, but cannot speak. Being the data hoarder I am, I immediately wanted numbers, so I built Muscle Memory to help me feed them. It's like leetcode but better. Challenges are more realistic, and I'd like to think the UX is more straightforward. It covers 12 languages and your code runs in a network-denied sandbox in your browser. No account needed. I want it to be a place to keep your hands sharp: short tasks, clear prompts, and difficulty that comes from solving the problem rather than figuring out what the question means. About the data (that I'm curious about): With your consent, Muscle Memory records your practice as raw events, including keystrokes, runs and submissions. Hoping to build an open dataset of how we write code in the AI era. That could help us understand how we approach problems, where we get stuck, and how we well do we retain our craft during this transition. Your individual results stay private unless you share them. “Stealth” mode keeps your data out of published findings, and you can export or delete everything. The data will be published as a report/notebook on the site itself, and be available raw under MIT license (parquet) once we reach a critical mass of sorts, so it makes sense to share. The code is also MIT-licensed on GitHub (https://github.com/ekkuleivonen/muscle-memory). I wrote more about why I built it in the manifesto here: https://musclememory.run/manifesto. I'd especially like to hear what surprised you about your first attempt. Try it out here: https://musclememory.run

projects.title: Railse：一个人同时开几个 AI 编程 agent，审批推到手机上点一下
projects.author: Railse547
projects.summary: 最近几个月我一直同时开着 Claude Code 、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 写代码。agent 本身跑得挺好，烦的是它每次要跑命令、改文件都停下来等我按「允许」。三个终端轮流翻，经常翻到的时候它已经等了十分钟；出去吃个饭，回来每个都停在第一条 git push 上。开 yolo 全放行又不敢，一句 rm -rf 出去就没有后悔药。 所以我写了 Railse：每条审批先过一遍规则，规则定不了的推到手机，我在手机上点一下，agent 接着跑。 它怎么做： - 三家 CLI 的权限钩子都接到本机一个守护进程，规则只写一套。 - 每条请求先定风险档：只读和改项目里的文件直接放行； curl 、npm install 这类联网的，git push 、deploy 这类对外的，rm -rf 、git reset --hard 这类不可逆的，都问。 - 定不了的推到手机，Web Push 通知，点开批准或拒绝。批准时勾「记住」，当场存成规则，下次同类的不问。 - 对外和不可逆的永远不能被「记住」放行，只能自己手写规则。 - Railse 自己挂了不卡 agent：守护进程没起、hub 连不上超过 30 秒，CLI 弹自己的审批框，最坏就是回到没装的样子。 hub 自己部署，一个 Go 二进制，也有 Fly.io 的现成配置；手机网页由 hub 托管，不用另外部署。命令里认得出的 token 、密码在本机就换成 再上报。 现状：v0.1.2 ，我自己在用。已知的限制：Gemini CLI 的钩子只能拒绝不能放行； Codex 的钩子只在交互会话里生效； iPhone 要加到主屏幕才能收推送； hub 是单机 SQLite 。 开源，Apache 2.0： https://github.com/xufei547/railse-opc 一行安装：curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xufei547/railse-opc/main/install.sh | sh 想听两种反馈：你同时开几个 agent 的时候是怎么处理审批的；规则表有判错的（该放行的问了、该问的放行了）直接提 issue ，我会优先看。

projects.title: 用 Web Components 做了个全栈框架 Gemkit，首屏 JS 26KB， SSR 性能和 SvelteKit 差不多
projects.author: 594mantou
projects.summary: 几年前在这发过我写的 Web Components 库 Gem （ https://v2ex.com/t/738230 ），一直有个硬伤：只有客户端渲染。连它自带的文档站生成器 gem-book 也是 CSR ，搜索引擎基本收录不到啥东西。 之前在这问过 React SSR 和自定义元素怎么配合（ https://v2ex.com/t/998353 ），当时我自己回复说「用 jsdom 模拟生成 ShadowDOM 理论上也行」。后来真这么干了： 1. 先用 jsdom 做原型，跑通了序列化（输出 Declarative Shadow DOM ）和水合（复用服务端的 DOM ，不重建） 2. 再把 jsdom 去掉，直接渲染成字符串，用 AsyncLocalStorage 做请求隔离，支持流式输出，这就是 gem-ssr 3. 最近参考 Next.js 和 SvelteKit ，在 gem-ssr 上做了应用框架 Gemkit ## 长啥样 一个文件就是一个页面： ```ts // src/pages/blog/[slug].ts @page ({ load: ({ params }) => getPost(params.slug), title: ({ data }) => data.title, }) export default class PostPage extends GemElement { @property data?: Post; @template() #content = () => html` ${this.data?.title} `; } ``` 只在服务端跑的代码放同名的 `[slug].server.ts` ，可以读 cookie 、redirect 、处理表单 actions ，不会打包到客户端。用过 SvelteKit 的应该很熟悉。 其他能力： - 文件路由、嵌套布局、i18n - 默认 SSG ，部署静态托管就行；需要的页面可以按请求渲染，也支持 ISR - `@server()` 元素只在服务端渲染，代码和依赖不进客户端；`@lazy()` 元素用户交互时才加载代码水合，第一次点击不会丢 - 本身就是个 Rsbuild 插件，Rsbuild 的东西照常用 - 内置 Vercel / Netlify / Cloudflare 适配 ## 和其他框架比了下 用 RealWorld （ Medium 克隆）各实现了一遍，同一个后端、同一份数据： | | 首页 JS (gzip) | Lighthouse | FCP | SSR req/s | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | Gemkit | 25.9 KB | 100 | 906 ms | 1382 | | SvelteKit | 44.0 KB | 100 | 1285 ms | 1437 | | Nuxt | 85.8 KB | 99 | 1656 ms | 1042 | | Next.js | 103.5 KB | 96 | 908 ms | 317 | SSR 吞吐 SvelteKit 略高一点，两个其实都快到后端的上限了。测试代码、复现步骤和原始数据都在这： https://github.com/mantou132/realworld/tree/framework-comparison/frameworks ，觉得测得不对的欢迎指出来。 ## 不足 - 个人项目，还是 0.x ，没在大项目里用过 - 客户端导航是先改 URL 再渲染新页面，加载期间会看到新 URL + 旧页面，后面再改 ## 试试 ```sh npm create gemkit@latest my-app ``` - 文档： https://gemkit.gemjs.org/zh - 仓库： https://github.com/mantou132/gem - 完整的过程写了篇文章（英文）： https://dev.to/mantou132/from-client-only-to-ssr-building-gemkit-a-sveltekit-style-framework-for-web-components-8ag 欢迎拍砖，觉得有意思的话点个 star 吧。

github.name: JhuoW/OpenMathpix
github.description: An open-source alternative to Mathpix Snip Tool. Instantly extract LaTeX, math equations, and text from images and screenshots. | 开源 Mathpix 替代工具，支持公式截图转 LaTeX

projects.summary: OpenMathpix 是一款把公式截图转为 LaTeX 的桌面工具，适合写论文、整理数学笔记和制作课件。集成 Pix2Text MFR-1.5，首次下载模型后即可在 CPU 上离线识别，无需 Python、显卡或 API 账号。支持快捷截图、图片粘贴与拖入、公式预览、复制及历史记录，提供 Windows 便携版。 亮点 作者自荐。希望让日常写论文、整理数学笔记时的公式录入更方便。 本地公式识别：集成 Pix2Text MFR-1.5，首次下载约 120 MB 模型后即可离线运行。本地模式下截图在本机 CPU 上处理，无需部署 Python、GPU 或大语言模型服务。 完整的桌面使用流程：支持快捷键截图、粘贴与拖入图片；识别后可预览公式、复制 LaTeX，并在历史记录中重新查看。 可直接试用：提供 Windows x64 便携 EXE 和中英文使用说明，模型下载带进度、完整性校验及修复入口。 识别引擎可选：保留 PaddleOCR API 配置入口，可按需使用云端或自托管服务处理文字、表格及文档版面。 实现可供学习：使用 Electron、TypeScript 和 ONNX Runtime，将专用视觉模型推理放在独立后台进程中，附有测试和可复现的公式样例。 本地 MFR 引擎主要用于单个公式截图；识别模型来自 Pix2Text，本项目侧重桌面截图、推理接入与结果管理。 试用入口： Windows 便携版下载 中文使用说明 启动应用后，在 Settings 中选择 Local MFR-1.5，点击 Download MFR-1.5 下载模型，再点击 Save & Test Local Model。Windows 本地推理需要 Microsoft Visual C++ x64 运行库。

projects.author: jryang1997

github.name: jryang1997/MenuBarMijia
github.description: Native macOS (Swift 6 + SwiftUI) & Windows 11 (Tauri v2) menu-bar/tray controller for Xiaomi Mijia & Home Assistant with hold-to-talk voice control · 跨端米家与 HA 菜单栏智控中心

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个我写的开源桌面小工具 MenuBarMijia（MIT 协议）。 平时在电脑前写代码或码字时，想开关灯、把吸顶灯切到月光模式、调空调温度，或者看一眼插座功率，往往得拿起手机点米家 App，或者喊小爱同学（容易打断思路，晚上还会听一串语音回复）。所以我做了一个常驻在 macOS 菜单栏和 Windows 11 系统托盘的控制器。 主要功能： 米家扫码直连或接入 Home Assistant：打开设置用手机米家 App 扫码就能同步家庭和设备，不用额外部署服务器；已有 Home Assistant 的 Mac 用户也可以通过局域网 WebSocket 接入，程序会自动把同一台物理设备拆散的开关、功率、用电量、童锁等实体合成一张卡片。 键盘拼音搜索与按住说话：按 ⌥M（Windows 下 Alt+M）呼出面板，直接敲拼音首字母（比如 sftd 找「书房台灯」）回车开关，方向键调亮度和温度；也可以用鼠标按住菜单栏图标直接说「关客厅灯」「再暗一点」「10 分钟后关书房灯」，松手即发，没有唤醒词，也不播报语音。明确的中英文指令在本地直接解析，复杂说法可以按需接你自己的大模型接口。 跟着 Mac 状态自动执行（macOS）：支持锁屏/合盖离开时自动关灯、唤醒回来开灯，或外接显示器插拔触发场景；同时提供 4 个 macOS「快捷指令」（Shortcuts）动作与 menumijia:// URL 调用。 防误触与用电统计：批量操作会弹出 10–15 秒撤销条（10 分钟内也能直接说「撤销」），只恢复那次操作改过的属性；「全关」需要按住 0.6 秒，默认排除插座和扫地机。内置插座本地用电统计，只按电表累计读数算增量，不用功率乘时间估算。 安装与试用（内置离线演示家庭，不绑设备也能直接试界面）： bash brew install --cask jryang1997/tap/menubarmijia

projects.title: Show HN: Crulon – Business phone where AI does the work, humans make the calls
projects.author: rayn11
projects.summary: Hi HN, I’m Rayhan. Crulon is a business phone system where an AI agent answers the line and your team works alongside it. You can talk with our demo agent right in your browser, no sign-up: https://crulon.ai/#talk Why I built it: I’ve spent eight years as a software and network engineer, mostly building tools for internet providers, and kept watching small support teams lose customers in the seams. Calls missed after hours. Calls passed from a bot to a person who had to start over. Most voice AI products are a bot sitting on someone else’s phone line, so a handoff means forwarding to another number and losing the context. We built the phone system and the agent as one thing. What that gets you: The handoff happens inside the same system. When something isn’t the AI’s job, it asks the caller, then rings your team (in the browser or on a desk phone) with a note on why they’re calling. Live calls: anyone with permission can listen to an AI call (no one on the call can hear them) and take it over. It’s the same call, with no transfer and no hold music; the AI just leaves. Tools: the agent can call any API you define in an Action builder (look up the caller, open a ticket), and it checks with the caller before changing anything. Outbound campaigns: the agent works through a call list for reminders, renewals and follow-ups, and puts interested people through to your team. SIP desk phones, and bring-your-own-carrier so you can keep your numbers. If you run out of AI minutes, calls follow your fallback route (ring the team, voicemail) instead of dropping, and the refused call isn’t billed. How it’s built, briefly: calls come in over SIP into Call Flows (menus, queues, schedules), and your team answers in the browser or on SIP desk phones. Each agent runs on one of two engines. Classic transcribes, thinks, then speaks, so you get exact wording and English, Spanish and French. Live is a full-duplex speech model that listens while it talks and hands tool work to a second model. One fun problem with that split was teaching the agent when to hang up, which I wrote up here: https://crulon.ai/blog/teaching-a-voice-agent-to-hang-up It isn’t a CRM; it works alongside yours. Built-in Apps connect it to systems like billing and network tools, and anything with a web API plugs in through the Action builder. Pricing is per seat ($24, $49 or $89 a month) with a pool of AI minutes; human calls are included. If you sign up this month, HN30 takes 30% off the first 3 months. I’ll be here all day. Try the agent, try to trip it up, and tell me what you’d want from a phone system like this.

projects.title: Show HN: Sectr – Serverless backend platform for easy deployment of AI agents
projects.author: donald_pinckney
projects.summary: Hey HN, I've been building Sectr, a backend-as-a-service for making it easy(ier) to develop and deploy AI agents. Deploying agents requires non-trivial systems design work. Consider a support agent: how do you stream messages to your frontend, how/where do you persist messages for frontend fetching later (or for auditing), and when the agent wants to issue a refund, do you spin-down the compute infra while it's waiting on human approval? Sectr aims to be the serverless abstraction and platform to provide these systems for you. No sign-up needed to try using the dev server: curl -fsSL https://sectr.dev/install.sh | sh # Install CLI sectr init my-agent && cd my-agent # Starter code sectr dev # Dev server, with UI to test chatting Sectr provides: - Streaming of every token, tool call and event, and persistence so they can be loaded fresh later. - Scaling up, and down to zero when the agent needs to wait, and resumption right to the suspended agent's state. - Human approved tools automatically use Sectr's suspension and resumption capabilities, no code needed from you. - AG-UI endpoint for any deployed agent so you can trivially hook up your frontend - Local dev server experience, so you can rapidly debug and iterate on your agent's behavior At the core, you can deploy any container image to Sectr as long as it implements a certain shaped HTTP endpoint. In practice, currently Sectr provides adapters to let you deploy your existing OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or Pydantic AI agents, with only 2 new lines of code: app = AgentApp(name="support") app.add_route("/chat", openai_agents(agent)) Certainly the hardest part of building Sectr was getting the resumption logic to be correct and invisible, across the Program State x Model Provider x Agent Framework matrix. For example, an earlier bug was when a model replied with text plus a tool call, Sectr would resume that as two separate messages, instead of one message with a text and tool part. This works, but breaks prompt caching (and might subtly change model behavior). Sectr is free during the beta (and can be tried locally without sign-up); I mainly want feedback, especially on dev & deployment experiences, any bugs, and what features would excite you. Introductory video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H-y3wynkKc0 Docs: https://docs.sectr.dev

projects.title: 做了个免费开源的小工具：一个 App Store 链接，各国用户都能打开
projects.author: wisteen
projects.summary: 做 iOS app 的应该都遇到过：从浏览器复制的 App Store 链接带国家代码，比如 `apps.apple.com/us/app/...`。发给其他国家的人，要么进的是美区页面，要么 app 在他那个区没上架，直接提示这个 App 在你所在的国家或地区不可用。 所以写了个小工具 Hither： https://hither.link/ 用法：粘贴任意国家的 App Store 链接或者 app ID ，得到 `hither.link/ `。 每次点击时： - Cloudflare Worker 从请求里读访客所在国家（`request.cf.country`） - 调 Apple 公开的 lookup 接口（`itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=...&country=...`）查这个区有没有上架，结果在边缘缓存一天 - 有上架：跳到访客自己国家的商店页面 - 没上架：先试美区，再按英国、加拿大、澳洲、德国、日本等大区依次找，找到有上架的为止 踩到的一个坑：iPhone / iPad 上 App Store app 只能打开当前账号所在国家的商店，跳到外区链接一样会提示不可用。所以 iOS 访客看到的是一个小页面，有 app 图标、名字和一个跳到有上架商店的按钮；电脑和安卓直接跳转。 其他： - 不用注册，没有数据库。链接里只有 app ID ，所以不会过期，也没人能改它跳去哪 - 上架前就能生成链接：用 App Store Connect 里 App 信息页的 Apple ID - 商店信息缓存最多一天，新上架的区可能要等一下才识别到 代码 MIT 开源，跑在 Cloudflare 免费套餐上，想自己部署一份也很快： https://github.com/wisteenio/hither 接下来在考虑 Google Play 链接、自定义短名、二维码，大家觉得哪个更有用？也欢迎提我没想到的边界情况。

projects.title: Show HN: Limma – MCP for total recall and precision in data retrieval for agents
projects.author: BerendG
projects.summary: Hello, my name is Berend Graham. My cofounder Shiv Oberai and I have been working on Limma for a year now with the goal of building a proactive solution to the reliability issues that plague practical AI and agentic use in companies with RAG. Limma is a single MCP that exists for the sole purpose of ensuring that the right information is retrieved with every query and no information is skipped and or missed. This means total precision and recall. We've found that this approach leads to the lowest rate of hallucination vs. solely targeting agent action verification which has made tremendous strides in capability. We do this by building a map and structuring all data-points within unstructured data as well as federating structured data for addressability so that agents don't need to search through chunks directly and instead only get the right information . We wanted this to be extremely easy to use so that anyone can set it up and try it within minutes so that the precision issues (especially with large quantities of data) that LLMs struggle with can finally be remedied. We use self-hosted models (primarily Qwen models as of current) so that the system can be deployed on one's own server if needed, and also to optimize for speed. We have a free monthly version on our website if anyone would like to try it out and provide feedback!

It is running all my home lab, nextcloud, gitlab and production websites for clients for the few last months. Quick links for those who want to test: https://dinemic.com - project page https://console.dinemic.com - hosted control plane, if you want to test it with your own vps and domain, without setting up whole stack https://gitlab.cloudover.io/dinemic/docs - project documentation In high availability section of documentation you will also find concepts and design of its components and sample analysis of downtime when things go wrong with your infra. projects.title: Show HN: Mainplane – Agent in Go that lives on your old PC, drives your laptop
projects.author: Alexander9
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Alexander. Yes, this is another agent harness. Here is why I built one anyway. I was engineer #2 at Browser Use, where I built our agent harness and the evals behind it, including BU Bench, which became a default benchmark for browser agents. I left in September to build Mainplane. The problem: local agents die with your laptop, and cloud agents can't reach your work. Many cloud platforms ask you to "select a repository", but my work is not that simple. I work across a desktop, a Mac mini and a laptop, and much of it is not in git. So I loaded Ubuntu on my old 2012 desktop and made it my Mainplane server. It has run for four weeks at a load average of 0.02, because the agents' tools run on other machines. How it works: it is a control plane architecture. The server runs the harness. It holds your API keys and every session, makes the LLM calls, and routes each tool call to a worker. The workers are your other machines, connected over a built-in private WireGuard network. A bash command runs in the worker's terminal, not on the server. Shared drives let projects move across machines. The agent works on your machines just like you would, but its state lives on the server, and your keys never leave it. Some design choices: - Every session is one append-only file. This is the agent state, and it is easily readable. If something breaks, you can resume it from the file. Observability comes for free: agent traces are just these state files. - Small by design. The system prompt is 3k tokens, and there are just two kinds of tools: shell and file (read, write, edit). At Browser Use, I learned the bitter lesson and found frontier models did better when I deleted all our helper functions. So I made the same bet here: bash is all you need. - No compaction. When a session fills up, /continue starts a new one that greps the previous state file, retrieving the context it needs, instead of reading a lossy summary. A /compact on a 400k-token session takes a while to write its summary. A /continue into a brand new session starts at once. - No permission prompts. A hyperintelligent misaligned agent WILL find a way around a permission system. The better strategy is giving the agent full unbounded access to a local computer, and only putting what you trust the agent with on that computer. - Why Go. WireGuard is written in Go, so the network compiles right into a 20 MB binary. Go is made for production servers, LLMs write it well, and the simplicity of Go matches how I like to build. Mainplane works with a Claude or ChatGPT subscription on the regular usage limits, or any API key. I would love your feedback, especially brutal and honest feedback and tasks that the harness cannot do. I'll be here all day to answer questions.

projects.author: pancomplex

github.name: FrigadeHQ/hob
github.description: An easier way to use AI on your own computer. A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux. Private, and works offline.

projects.summary: Hey HN, I'm Christian and this is a new OSS project I've been noodling on for the last couple of weeks. Hob is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works on your files the way the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps do, except the model runs on your own computer. It uses open-weight models (currently Gemma 4 and gpt-oss). All your chats and files never leave your system. The only things that go online are web search (can be turned off in settings) and any MCP connectors you add yourself. Main features: - Automatically finds the best open-weight model for your hardware on first install (Mac/Linux/Windows) - Writes sandboxed Python code for ad hoc tools (data processing, document conversion, graphs etc.) - Built-in web search (powered by SearXNG) - MCP support - Image recognition - CRUD to your local filesystem - Works fully offline with no internet Before building this I tried every local AI app I could find, but it seemed each one had different problems. The main thing I noticed is that none of them could do what the ChatGPT and Claude apps do with your files, e.g. read and change files in a folder, look at images, run code in a sandbox, draw a chart. The most advanced thing any of them did was paste a plain text file into a small context window, which basically failed as soon as you had a file larger than a few KB. I couldn't find anything that could easily parse images and bigger PDFs. The OSS solutions that were more advanced all seemed to default to hosted models (either OSS or closed), which defeats the entire point of the privacy that on-device OSS offers. They also seemed to push towards an account/open-core style business. I build it using Electron bridged with llama.cpp in its own process. On initial load, the system will try and figure out if you have a compatible graphics card and if not default to CPU-only (I ran into a lot of issues of graphics card beeing seemingly compatible but then crashing on first query, there's a whole saga to this lol). Code execution happens in a sandbox that can only write to the chat's folder and has no network unless asked (sandbox-exec on macOS, Landlock on Linux and a low-integrity process on Windows). Images go to a small Qwen3-VL model. Dictation is a local Whisper model. The hardest part was definitely to get the smaller models to use tools reliably. Ran into a ton of issues of 4B models happily saying "here's your chart" without ever calling the chart tool or get stuck in an infinite call loop. I spent a fair amount of the work building guards vs tweaking prompts (that didn't really work for small models). I understand the pushback that local models are weaker than frontier cloud models. This is true, but for most tasks for most normal people, I'd argue you rarely need the newest frontier model. From my own evals, systems with 16+ GB of RAM do really well, and if you have a GPU or more RAM, you get very close to what you'll get out of the box with a frontier hosted model. Excited to hear what you think and see how it runs on other systems!

github.description: Borderless Windows HUD & CLI quota monitor for Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Grok, Google Antigravity (agy), Magpie & LiteLLM. Tracks multi-account 5h/7d rate-limit windows, redeems Claude/Codex limit-reset credits, and doubles as an mpv live wallpaper.

projects.summary: 一个 Windows 无边框、无任务栏图标的 AI 订阅额度 HUD 悬浮窗与副屏仪表盘，同屏实时监控 Claude Code、ChatGPT Codex、Grok、Google Antigravity、LiteLLM 等多账号的 5 小时与 7 天限额窗口；支持一键探测并兑换官方隐藏的限额重置券；双击 Ctrl 秒切 mpv 动态壁纸。 解决了什么痛点？ 1. 多账号与多平台额度盲盒：做严肃编码任务时，多开 Claude Code / Codex / Grok / agy 经常突然撞上 5 小时限额墙或周上限。以往要在各个网页或 CLI 里繁琐查询，usage-float 直接以极低资源占用在副屏或桌面角常驻展示全部账号的动态进度条与剩余重置时间。 2. 官方隐藏福利一键兑换： Anthropic 为 Claude Code CLI 用户提供了周重置券（cedarember）与 5 小时碰墙重置券（junipertide）； OpenAI 官方对部分 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅也发放了限额重置券（/backend-api/wham/rate-limit-reset-credits）； usage-float 模拟官方 CLI 原生协议安全嗅探重置券资格，有券时直接在界面提示，点击即可一键兑换回满血，绝不浪费。 3. 无感常驻与桌面摸鱼/护眼切换：副屏平时是干净专业的黑金/暗黑仪表盘，双击 Ctrl（或自定义热键）无缝切换为你本地收藏的 mpv 4K/60fps 动态壁纸或画廊，兼顾生产力与视觉愉悦。 4. Agent 本地查询友好：除了图形界面，提供 python usagefloat.py once（或读取本地原子写入的 ~/.usage-float/usage-cache.json），方便本地 Agent 路由器无网络请求开销直接获取账号剩余额度。 配套开源工具自荐（同一开发者生态） 为了让多订阅 AI 编码体验更完整，我们在同一生态下还开源了另外两个轻量实用的工具，供感兴趣的同学参考： 1. AgentCompass

projects.title: Show HN: Markdown is 40× more token-efficient with SQLite
projects.author: richardcrng
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Richard, founder of Native. I'm working on open-source context ownership, to stop AI centralisation: https://github.com/withnative/native My first focus has been making Markdown vaults powerful enough so that teams can self-host all of their context (messaging, docs and projects), without it being externally fragmented or rate-limited. I'm sharing some early results: Markdown vaults can be 40× more efficient with SQLite! https://www.withnative.ai/research-and-posts/markdown-contex... Here's some of the main ideas: - SQLite or Markdown folders, you pick. You can project the same authoritative event log into either form; more projection formats will follow (e.g. maybe neo4j; we do use a graph structure). - Empirically: SQLite is better for agents! On a 120 trial evaluation for 11,000 records, agents use 40× fewer tokens with SQLite vs Markdown, per correct answer. - Everything is a file or SQLite row. Messages, documents and projects: all can be modelled in your vault. You get local-first collaboration with teammates, synced to a cloud of your choice. - You can render your vault with arbitrary UI. Your WhatsApp-like UI speaks to your teammate's Slack-like UI; both are just views over the same database. A few things I've learned building this: - Agents do pretty well even without SQL if you give them strongly typed Markdown frontmatter. This was one arm of the trial I ran. I didn't have any clear expectations, but it was cool to watch: agents ended up writing Python scripts to do SQL-like queries. - Cumulatively, cached input tokens can get expensive. I feel silly in hindsight here. I'd gotten used to letting my sessions run long, "It's all cached so it's very cheap". But when I looked at my results here, over 2/3 of the token bill on long sessions was cached input... - "Markdown vaults don't scale as well as databases" isn't as self-evident as I think. This is why I decided to benchmark it... I've had some very blank stares when I try to explain how Markdown files might break at true agent-scale volume. Unfortunately, the dataset is private, because it's two months of my own work. I am considering open-sourcing it even so, but there is definitely some embarrassing stuff in there. TBD... I know that independent result verification matters! The core engine that I evaluated is open-source, with more to be released soon: https://github.com/withnative/native If you're interested in trying connected context on an open engine, you can get updates from our website or email me directly: richard@withnative.ai https://www.withnative.ai/

projects.title: 飞飞掼蛋
projects.author: sandyshen

github.name: shenpengfeisandy-beep/feifei-guandan-feedback
github.description: 飞飞掼蛋：提前缓存，离线练习与同网组局；有网扫码约好友。1–4人、20款背景与团建试用，游戏源码私有。

projects.summary: ## 提前缓存，没网照样玩 飞飞掼蛋，是我做给朋友的一张随身牌桌。飞机上、地下室、深山里，没带扑克牌时，也想用手机来一局。 ### 没有外网，怎么玩？ 出发前，每台手机先联网打开游戏，确认‘离线资源已保存’。 - 一个人：缓存后可直接和3位电脑练习。 - 朋友一起：各自缓存好，再连接同一个可互通的 Wi-Fi 或手机热点，选择‘附近离线’，完成邀请与回应的双向扫码。多人仍需要设备间连接，当前网页版不支持纯蓝牙联机。 - 有互联网：各用自己的5G或Wi-Fi，选择‘在线快捷’，扫一次座位邀请就能加入，不要求同一个网络。 机上无线使用请遵守航司规定；酒店公共Wi-Fi可能隔离设备。多人局请房主保持页面前台。 ### 一到四人，都能开桌 缺位由电脑补齐，可指定对家。上传头像、改昵称，让牌友一眼认出你；20款个人背景各自选择，横竖屏自动适配。 进贡、还贡由玩家自行选择，支持内贡、双大王抗贡；本局打几，红桃对应级牌不能进贡。连续点‘提示’可轮换合法牌型；轮到谁会显示座位关系和名字，并提供语音提醒。两首独立背景音乐、快捷对话和表情，为牌桌添点热闹。 ### 人多时，也能办团建赛 支持8—32人的固定双人队，积分赛、淘汰赛、决赛与季军赛。团建联机目前是试用：队长手动录分、双方确认后计分，尚不自动收取各桌成绩。 ### 试玩与反馈 当前网页版免费试玩，无需注册。战绩保存在本机，可导出备份。iOS/安卓商店安装版与付费发行版尚未发布，不把计划中的功能当成已交付。实体手机兼容性和音画体验仍在持续验证。 制作人：飞飞。欢迎来玩，也欢迎提出具体修改建议。 反馈：shenpengfeisandy@gmail.com 公开反馈区：https://github.com/shenpengfeisandy-beep/feifei-guandan-feedback/issues 二维码打开的是游戏首页；加入朋友牌桌，请由房主在游戏里另发座位邀请。

projects.title: 独立站除了公开邮箱和微信二维码，还能怎么跟访客说上话？
projects.author: martin2013
projects.summary: 背景：个人博客，Hugo 生成，扔在 Cloudflare Pages 上，没有后端也没有数据库。 一直没放联系方式，原因有两个。公开邮箱三天就被爬虫抓走，垃圾邮件到现在还没清完；放个人微信二维码，等于要求每个想留言的人先加好友——多数人不会加，包括我自己。 但「有人找我时能第一时间知道」这件事一直没解决。把能想到的方案挨个试了一遍，记一下结论，也顺便求个更优解。 ### 先把需求拆成三条 1. **访客侧**：不注册、不加好友，邮箱和手机最好都能不填。 2. **站主侧**：消息落到手机上，且不要求我为此多装一个 App 、多开一个后台。 3. **隐私侧**：访客说的是私事，服务端最好别存。 后面的评价都对着这三条，而不是对着功能表。 ### 一、评论系统 最省事的是 [Disqus]( https://disqus.com)，但国内加载不稳，页面上还会塞它自己的推荐位。[Waline]( https://waline.js.org)、[Twikoo]( https://twikoo.js.org)、[Artalk]( https://artalk.js.org) 这几个开源的体验好得多，代价是要自己部署服务端并配数据库——对纯静态博客来说，为了留言区维护一套后端不太划算。[Giscus]( https://giscus.app) 不用额外部署，基于 GitHub Discussions ，但访客得有 GitHub 账号，我这点读者里一半没有。 这类方案的定位很清楚：**适合文章下面的公开讨论，不适合私下的联系**。公示在评论区里的内容，没人会写自己的联系方式。 ### 二、客服 SaaS [Tawk.to]( https://www.tawk.to) 免费档很能打，[Crisp]( https://crisp.chat) 界面更精致，[Intercom]( https://www.intercom.com) 是企业定价。它们的设计前提是「客服坐席」：开面板、装 App 、配工作时间，脚本还会给页面加一两百 KB 。个人博客一天来不了几个访客，为它装个 App 不划算。 还有一个容易忽略的细节：访客常常在窗口资源加载完之前就走了。 ### 三、表单转邮件 [Formspree]( https://formspree.io) 这类把表单提交转成邮件，或者自己写个 Cloudflare Worker 转发。门槛低、够用，但「邮件」这个通道的时效性是硬伤：我一天开两次邮箱，访客发完就去干别的了。 适合非实时的需求收集（合作、反馈、投稿）。 ### 四、IM 中继 这一类是把消息推到站主本来就在用的聊天软件里。国内有几个成熟服务：[Server 酱]( https://sct.ftqq.com)、[PushPlus]( https://www.pushplus.plus)、[WxPusher]( https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com)，都是「一条 HTTP 请求 → 微信」的管道，最初是为服务器告警、脚本通知设计的。 注意它们解决的是「我主动推给自己」，不解决「访客说话」——这两件事经常被混为一谈。 要同时满足「访客能说话」和「站主在 IM 里回」，就得有个站内聊天页做入口。这类东西我找到的不是要自建就是半自建，最后我用的是[**信鸽**]( https://sendtk.com/?from=v2ex)：访客打开链接、填个称呼就能发消息（邮箱手机可选），消息进微信或 Telegram ，我引用那条消息回复就回到对应访客；聊天记录不落服务端，只存在访客浏览器里；嵌入是一行 iframe ，不用部署、不用配数据库。 ### 怎么选（按场景，不按谁更强） - 想让文章下面有人公开讨论：[Waline]( https://waline.js.org) / [Twikoo]( https://twikoo.js.org) / [Giscus]( https://giscus.app)。 - 有客服团队、要 SLA：[Tawk.to]( https://www.tawk.to) / [Crisp]( https://crisp.chat) / [Intercom]( https://www.intercom.com)。 - 只收非实时的合作邮件：[Formspree]( https://formspree.io) 这类表单转邮件。 - 只想「有人找我时，手机上立刻能回」：IM 中继这一类，前提是它有站内聊天页。 ### 说清楚立场 第四类那个工具（[**信鸽**]( https://sendtk.com/?from=v2ex)）是我做的，所以看到这一段时你可以打折听。它的短板我直接列： - 免费档每天 20 条消息（通知与聊天合计），流量一起来就不够； - 不是工单系统：没有历史归档、没有多人协作，服务端不存聊天记录，回头找对话只能翻微信； - 海外访客更适合走 Telegram ，纯微信适合站主人在国内。 前三类的链接与评价没有因为我要推自己的东西而改动。 ### 求教 你们站上现在放的是什么？有没有「访客零门槛 + 站主手机直达」的其它方案，我大概率漏了。

projects.title: [开源推荐] AWS Lightsail 流量池省钱计算器：算出加几台实例最划算
projects.author: yt1988

github.name: yt1988/lightsail-cost-saver
github.description: Free single-page calculator for AWS Lightsail data transfer pools: forecast overage and find the cheapest way to add bandwidth. 10 languages.

projects.summary: Lightsail 同地区、同规格的实例共享一个流量池，超额费每 TB 约 $92，而加一台 $5 的 IPv6 实例每 TB 只要 $2.5。这个纯前端工具帮你算清这笔账：填入本月已用流量，它会预测月底用量、额度哪天用完、会多付多少钱，并对比加 0～3 台实例的总花费，给出最省的方案。数据只存在浏览器本地。 亮点 规则来自官方文档和 AWS Support 的回答：入站出站都扣额度、只对出站超额收费、月中开通按小时折算、已产生的超额无法被新实例抵消；19 个地区的价格由脚本从 AWS Price List API 拉取，额度减半的地区也已算进去。 不只告诉你会不会超，还给出可执行的方案：额度预计哪天用完、加几台最省、比不加省多少，一键加进配置；只知道月总量时有整月规划模式。 能直接交给 AI Agent：站点提供 llms.txt，计算模块 calc.js 和 prices.json 都允许跨域读取，在 ChatGPT、Claude 等 Agent 或自己的脚本里调用，结果和网页完全一致。 纯静态单页、无后端，可以免费部署到 Cloudflare Workers 或 Vercel，也可以一行 docker run；计算核心有回归测试，在 CI 中运行。

projects.title: 用 ONNX Runtime Web 把 AI 和弦识别放到了浏览器本地运行，做了个 Chord Finder
projects.author: limerain
projects.summary: 最近做了一个音乐相关的 Web 工具，ChordFold 。 地址： https://chordfold.com/ 主要功能是：用户选择一段 MP3 或 WAV 音频，AI 自动识别里面的和弦，以及和弦随时间的变化。 和一些需要上传音频到服务器的识别服务不同，我选择了浏览器本地推理的方案。 目前的技术方案： 使用 BTC 系列和弦识别模型 模型转换为 ONNX 格式 通过 ONNX Runtime Web 在浏览器里执行 WASM 推理 对音频进行解码和 CQT 特征提取 模型预测后对结果进行平滑，生成和弦时间轴 用户侧的操作流程也比较简单： 选择本地音频文件 首次使用时下载识别模型 在浏览器本地分析音频 得到按时间排列的和弦结果 点击时间轴上的和弦，可以跳到对应位置回听 可以切换查看支持的吉他和弦指法图、钢琴音符参考 目前限制音频最大 14MB 、最长 10 分钟。 选择本地推理主要有几个考虑： 第一，音频不需要上传服务器，相对更有隐私优势。 第二，不需要为每个用户的识别请求支付云端 GPU 推理费用。 第三，工具本身不需要用户注册账号。 但缺点也很明显。 首先，模型首次下载需要时间。 其次，不同设备上的 WASM 推理性能差异比较大。 还有就是和弦识别的准确率问题。对于干净的钢琴、吉他音频，相对容易分析；复杂编曲、失真、转位和弦以及快速切换的片段，模型仍然可能出现错误。 目前不打算宣传什么 99% 准确率，实际上还没有可靠的统一准确率测试数据。 接下来主要想继续优化识别效果、模型加载和结果交互。 想请教一下 V 友： 有没有做过音乐信息检索（ MIR ）或者音频模型部署的？ 对于浏览器本地音频推理，ONNX Runtime Web + WASM 还有哪些值得优化的方向？ 有更适合浏览器端运行、准确率又比较好的和弦识别模型推荐吗？ 如果你会弹吉他或者钢琴，也欢迎拿一段音频测试一下，看看识别效果怎么样。 技术交流和产品体验方面的建议都欢迎。

projects.title: 【工具自荐】【AESTHETICA-10】一个永远只打 10 分的 AI 颜值评分（恶搞）
projects.author: aeroxy
projects.summary: 2017 年我自己做过一个 AI 颜值打分应用。快十年过去了，又看见了类似的网站：上传一张自拍，给你算出一个精确到小数点后两位的分数，比如 6.2/10，再顺手卖你一套“变美方案”。自己亲手做过，我的结论是：这东西从根上就是扯淡。分数主要量的是你的相机，光线、焦距、角度、距离一变，同一张脸的分数就跟着变，有的网站干脆建议你多传几张取平均。还有研究发现，离脸 30 厘米拍的自拍，会让鼻翼看起来比 1.5 米外拍的宽约 30%（JAMA Facial Plastic Surgery，2018）。精确到两位小数只是看起来像科学，本质是带进度条的星座运势。 所以这次我做了一个反过来的版本：仪器感一样不少，只是结论比较诚实：你本来就是 10 分。 真·人脸识别：在浏览器里用 MediaPipe 人脸关键点模型定位 478 个面部关键点，把“黄金比例”网格、颧骨、下颌角的标注精准贴到你脸上，然后全部无视。识别不到人脸就不画网格，直接显示“NO FACE IN FRAME · STILL 10/10”。 核心评分算法只有一行：return 10.00; 5 位专家人设：严谨的颅面物理学博士、巴黎高定选角导演、15 世纪佛罗伦萨雕塑家、算力过载的神经网络集群、无条件夸夸的吹捧科学家。每位都有自己的一套夸法、六维评分和一张煞有介事的人体测量数据表。 官方认证 PDF：一键导出 A4 证书，带你的照片、病例编号、六维评分、专家签名和印章，可用于各种争论、群聊和照镜子。 多种测试对象：支持上传、拖拽、摄像头实时追踪（拍下一帧再打分），也可以直接用内置样本：凌晨 5 点枕头印自拍、死亡仰拍角度、车管所证件照，以及一颗土豆。 隐私方面，照片全程不出浏览器，人脸识别在本地运行，只从 CDN 下载模型文件。没有后端、不上传、不存储，没有登录也没有付费。界面目前是英文。

projects.title: Show HN: Reusable, spectraly shaped Blue Noise point clouds
projects.author: adec314
projects.summary: Blue noise is the task of sampling a collection of points optimally placed to cover space randomly yet uniformly. -randomly: no periodic pattern or undesired ordered structure, to prevent aliasing effects. -uniformly: no empty regions, clusters... that would unavoidably appear by just using a raw random generator because of natural fluctuations. In spectral language, one can take the Fourier transform of the point cloud. For a blue noise, it's amplitude should be: - 0 or small at low frequencies. This ensures long-range order. - 1 or not too big at high frequencies (short-range disorder). Hence blue noise: Imagine sending light on the point cloud; in some abstract sense, only the blue (high frequency) will pass through. Many popular algorithms can sample blue noise: Poisson disks, void and clusters, Lloyd relaxation... but the bluest blue noise (those that show up as a hard 0-1 spectral step) comes from the most basic, brute-force algorithm you can imagine. Take points from a purely random generator, compare the Fourier transform with the 0-1 target, launch gradient descent... and wait. Wait because it has O(N^2) complexity. Well, it turns out in 2D / 3D, advanced fast Fourier techniques can bring it down to N log N, see https://github.com/martiniani-lab/FReSCo (not me), but this is limited to 2D / 3D point clouds. So, all this just to say that I launched a high-quality but slow blue noise optimiser on the GPU, collected the samples in a reusable database and hope it could interest people from graphics, statistical physics, maybe also quasi-Monte Carlo integration (but this one is just a maybe, simple Sobol sequences are better than blue noise on many tasks) or just curious hackers. Sampled clouds, all open access: 2D to 32D 1k to 130k points (and up to 30 millions in 2D / 3D thanks to the mentioned fast Fourier speed-up).

projects.summary: ## Steamcup：合上电脑，让任务接着跑 编译、渲染或跑 Agent 时，任务还没结束，Mac 却睡了。Steamcup 是一个原生 macOS 菜单栏小工具：点一下像素咖啡杯，让 Mac 保持唤醒；开启合盖模式后，合上盖子也能继续运行。 ### 怎么用 - 点杯子开启或关闭，右键设置 30 分钟到 8 小时的定时。 - 开启合盖模式，让屏幕熄灭、后台任务继续；首次需管理员授权。 - 可选择允许屏幕熄灭、锁屏时暂停，也可用 ⌃⌥W 快捷键切换。 - 配置命令行入口后，使用 `steamcup run -- <命令>`，醒到命令结束。 ### 下载与安装 介绍页有 12 秒功能示意短片、下载入口和完整安装说明：https://longado.github.io/steamcup/ 下载 Steamcup.zip，解压后将 Steamcup.app 拖进「应用程序」。当前版本尚未经过 Apple 公证，首次打开可能被 macOS 阻止，请按仓库安装说明处理。 ### 当前版本与边界 v1.3.2 Alpha，免费、MIT 开源，不需要账号或订阅，应用不发送网络请求。 下载包面向 macOS 14+，包含 Apple 芯片和 Intel 架构；真机验证来自 macOS 26 的 Apple 芯片 Mac，macOS 14–15 与 Intel 设备仍待实际验证。 合盖模式会更改系统睡眠设置，并安装后台恢复检查。正常关闭或定时结束后恢复设置；崩溃、强退后由后台检查恢复。设有过热和低电量停止机制，但尚未在真实过热、低电场景下验证触发效果。合盖运行时请保持通风，权限范围与卸载方法见仓库说明。 这是需要下载安装的 Mac 应用，网页是介绍与下载入口。配图为产品介绍页与功能示意。 源码：https://github.com/Longado/steamcup 欢迎反馈你的 macOS 版本、机型与具体使用过程。

projects.author: luobobo8965
projects.summary: 公司制度文档散在网盘、群聊、个人电脑，新人问、老人答，答的不一定是现行版本。试过 SaaS 知识库，卡在「数据出内网」和「按人头收费」两点，就自己写了一个。 只做一件事：把 Markdown 丢进 docs/，就能提问，回答带《文档》/章节出处，能点开核对原文；文档带可见范围（普通员工查不到财务制度，财务角色能看到）。全程不联网，零第三方依赖，一个文件 380 行。 几个实现上的小设计： - 分块：维护标题栈 + 段落，约 420 字一块，每块自带「《员工报销制度》/ 报销标准」这样的路径，回答时直接当引用 - 中文分词：二元组切分，不依赖分词库，英文数字按词切 - 召回：BM25 + TF-IDF 双路加权。第一版问「出差住宿报销上限」，第一条返回的是「差旅餐补」——加「查询词覆盖率」加权后才稳定命中住宿段落 - 回答默认抽取式，不生成。制度类问题最怕编造，返回原文让人自己核对 部署就两条命令：`python3 kb.py ingest` 建索引，`python3 kb.py serve` 起服务，目录拷到内网机器就能用。 演示（ 89 秒纯录屏）： https://youtu.be/cNloexteD4s 实现细节长文： https://juejin.cn/spost/7699848140908544010 代码： https://github.com/luobobo896 轻喷。主要想听检索排序和文档权限这两块还有哪些坑，或者你们公司现在怎么解决「制度找不到」这个问题。
